outcomes.text: kueleza matumizi ya kivumishi kirejeshi amba- ili kuyabainisha
kutambua kivumishi kirejeshi amba- katika matini
kutumia kivumishi kirejeshi amba- katika sentensi au vifungu vya maneno kwa usahihi
kufurahia kutumia kivumishi kirejeshi amba- katika sentensi au vifungu vya maneno

skills.name: Tambua na tumia kivumishi kirejeshi amba-
skills.mastery: Gives amba- with the ending that agrees with the noun before it (mwalimu ambaye, watoto ambao, kitabu ambacho, miti ambayo) and does not leave amba- bare, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
The amba- ending follows the class of the noun, which the child must know.

misconceptions.error: Uses amba- with the ending of another noun class (kitabu ambaye).

example.question: Kitabu ___ nilinunua ni kizuri.

misconceptions.cause: The child uses ambaye for every noun.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kitabu ___ nilinunua ni kizuri." with "ambaye" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A thing noun with ambaye among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Amba- huchukua mwisho unaolingana na ngeli ya nomino: kitabu ambacho, mwalimu ambaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the singular amba- form for many, or the plural for one (watoto ambaye).

example.question: Watoto ___ wanasoma ni werevu.

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the class but not the number.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Watoto ___ wanasoma ni werevu." with "ambaye" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A plural noun with the singular form among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Mtu mmoja: ambaye. Watu wengi: ambao.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

misconceptions.error: Leaves amba- without its ending (mama amba anauza).

example.question: Mama ___ anauza mboga ni shangazi yangu.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the stem but not that it needs an ending.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mama ___ anauza mboga ni shangazi yangu." with "amba" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with the bare stem amba.
misconceptions.feedback: Amba- haitumiki peke yake. Ina mwisho: ambaye, ambao, ambacho, ambayo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses amba- and the relative -ye- / -o- in the verb together (mtoto ambaye aliyekuja).

example.question: Ni ipi ni sahihi?

misconceptions.cause: Both ways of saying "who" are known and the child uses both to be sure.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni sahihi?" with "Mtoto ambaye aliyeshinda amepewa zawadi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show the two ways side by side: ambaye alishinda = aliyeshinda; never both.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia amba- au -ye- katika kitenzi, si vyote viwili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Matamshi Bora (Theme 3: Mahusiano)
learning_experiences: kutambua vitendawili katika chati, ubao au katika vifaa vya kidijitali (k.m. Adui mpenzi (Moto); Wanangu watatu daima wako pamoja (mafiga); kuku wangu watagia mibani (Nanasi),
kusikiliza vitendawili vikitegwa na kuteguliwa kupitia vyombo vya kidijitali,
kushiriki katika kutega na kutegua vitendawili akiwa na wenzake,
kujadiliana na mzazi au mlezi wake kuhusu vitendawili vinavyotegwa katika jamii yao.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, vitendawili vina umuhimu gani katika jamii?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kutega na kutegua vitendawili kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu majibu ya vitendawili.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza vitendawili vikitegwa na kuteguliwa.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoweza kutega na kutegua vitendawili.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu utegaji na uteguzi wa vitendawili wa wenzake.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kijami: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya matumizi ya vitendawili na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la mahusiano na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Social Studies.
sub_strands.design_notes: Second read left this for a person to confirm: no lessons figure.

outcomes.text: kutambua vitendawili kwenye matini mbalimbali
kutega na kutegua vitendawili ili kujenga matamshi bora
kuchangamkia matumizi ya vitendawili katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua vitendawili na uvitegue
skills.mastery: Picks the kitendawili (riddle) from a methali, a nahau and an ordinary sentence, and gives the answer to a known riddle, in 8 of 10 new items. Setting and guessing riddles aloud (outcome b) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 told riddles and solved them.

misconceptions.error: Takes a methali for a riddle.

example.question: Ni kitendawili kipi?

misconceptions.cause: Both are short sayings.
misconceptions.reveals: A riddle and a methali.
misconceptions.help: A riddle asks a hidden question and waits for the answer.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitendawili huficha jibu na humtaka mtu kukitegua. Methali hutoa funzo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a nahau for a riddle.

example.question: Ni kitendawili kipi?

misconceptions.cause: Both can be a short phrase.
misconceptions.reveals: A riddle and a nahau.
misconceptions.help: Can you guess an answer to it?
misconceptions.feedback: Nahau ni maneno yenye maana maalum. Kitendawili huuliza kwa mafumbo na kina jibu la kutegua.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes an ordinary sentence for a riddle.

example.question: Ni kitendawili kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not see that a riddle hides the thing it describes.
misconceptions.reveals: A riddle and a plain sentence.
misconceptions.help: Does the text name the thing, or hide it?
misconceptions.feedback: Kitendawili hakitaji kitu moja kwa moja; hukielezea kwa fumbo. Sentensi ya kawaida inataja wazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a thing that shares one detail with the riddle but is not the answer.

example.question: "Popote niendapo hunifuata." Jibu ni nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child picks the first thing that comes to mind.
misconceptions.reveals: A riddle with plausible answers.
misconceptions.help: Test each answer against every part of the riddle.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu la kitendawili lazima lilingane na kila sehemu yake. Hiyo si jibu sahihi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Theme 3: Mahusiano)
learning_experiences: kujadiliana na wenzake vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma makala kwa ufasaha,
kutazama vielelezo vya video vinavyoonyesha usomaji fasaha wa makala (k.v. hotuba, habari,) au na wenzake,

kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa la mahusiano kati ya watu katika jamii (k.v. sahibu /rafiki/ mwandani, mpenzi, mwana, ndugu, jirani, mwenza) katika matini andishi au ya kidijitali akizingatia matamshi bora,
kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno sahihi yasiyopungua 80 kwa dakika) ili wenzake wamtolee maoni,
kusoma kifungu akizingatia sauti ifaayo (k.v. kiwango cha sauti na kiimbo),
kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo panapofaa (k.v. ishara za uso na mikono zinazozingatia tamaduni),
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kusoma makala akizingatia vipengele vya usomaji bora.
key_inquiry_questions: Unaposoma kifungu ni mambo yapi unayozingatia ili kusoma ifaavyo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kujadiliana kuhusu vipengele vya kusoma kwa ufasaha.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kwa ufasaha.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotumia ishara zifaazo wakati wa kusoma kifungu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli ya kusoma.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji wanapojadili vipengele vya usomaji bora.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika mjadala wakati wa shughuli ya ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuwasomea wenzake kifungu.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake kujadili vipengele vya usomaji bora.
sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kijamii na wa kitaifa: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa ufasaha na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la mahusiano na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Social Studies.
sub_strands.design_notes: Second read left this for a person to confirm: no lessons figure.

outcomes.text: kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma kwa ufasaha
kusoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora
kusoma kifungu kwa kasi ifaayo
kusoma kifungu kwa kutumia sauti ipasavyo
kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo
kuchangamkia kusoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya usomaji

skills.name: Tambua vipengele vya kusoma kwa ufasaha
skills.mastery: Names what a fluent reader does (clear sounds, a fitting speed, a fitting voice, a pause at the koma and the kikomo, a rising voice for a question, fitting gestures) and does not take speed or loudness for fluency, in 8 of 10 new items. Reading a passage aloud (outcomes b to e) is judged by a teacher listening.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 named the features of fluent reading.

skills.name: Soma kifungu kwa sauti kwa matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo, sauti ifaayo na ishara
skills.mastery: Reads a short passage aloud at a speaking pace, pauses at the koma and the kikomo, raises the voice for a question and shows feeling for an exclamation, says every sound clearly (no l for r), and uses a matching gesture, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app picks the better reading of a line in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: The features of fluent reading come before doing it.
Grade 5 read a passage aloud fluently.

misconceptions.error: Takes fast reading for fluent reading, or very slow reading for careful reading.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: Si haraka sana wala polepole sana

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks the best reader is the fastest.
misconceptions.reveals: A question on speed with extremes as options.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the listener can follow every word.
misconceptions.feedback: Kusoma kwa ufasaha si kusoma haraka sana. Kasi ifaayo ni ya wastani, ili msikilizaji aelewe kila neno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a loud voice for a fitting voice.

example.question: Sauti ipasavyo wakati wa kusoma ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: Sauti inayosikika wazi bila kupiga kelele

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks louder is better.
misconceptions.reveals: A question on the voice with shouting and whispering as options.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the voice is clear and comfortable to listen to.
misconceptions.feedback: Sauti ipasavyo ni ile inayosikika wazi bila kupiga kelele wala kunong'ona.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads on without a pause at the koma and the kikomo.

example.question: Ukifika kwenye koma wakati wa kusoma, ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads word after word and does not use the marks.
misconceptions.reveals: A question on the pause at a koma or a kikomo.
misconceptions.help: Read the sentence aloud and listen to where the voice rests.
misconceptions.feedback: Alama za uakifishi zinatuonyesha mahali pa kupumzika: kidogo kwenye koma na kwa muda mrefu zaidi kwenye kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Ndugu wawili walipatana na kuishi kwa amani tena."?
example.wrong_answer: Ndugu ... wawili ... walipatana ... na ... kuishi ... kwa ... amani ... tena.
example.correct_answer: Ndugu wawili walipatana na kuishi kwa amani tena.

misconceptions.cause: The child is still decoding each word and has not yet learnt to read a phrase as one piece.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Ndugu wawili walipatana na kuishi kwa amani tena."?" with "Ndugu ... wawili ... walipatana ... na ... kuishi ... kwa ... amani ... tena." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.
misconceptions.feedback: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, ili kila neno lisikike

misconceptions.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; the child has not been asked whether listeners understood.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Time two readings: one very fast, one at speaking pace; listeners answer one question after each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a question and an exclamation in the same flat voice as a statement.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, umewahi kumsamehe rafiki aliyekukosea?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the mark at the end.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, umewahi kumsamehe rafiki aliyekukosea?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that matches each reading.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads on through the koma and the kikomo without a pause.

example.question: Unasoma: "Ala, kumbe ninyi ni ndugu!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?
example.wrong_answer: hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: kwenye koma na kwenye kikomo au alama ya hisi

misconceptions.cause: The marks are read as decoration; the child has not linked them to breath.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unasoma: "Ala, kumbe ninyi ni ndugu!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?" with "hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap once at a koma, twice at a kikomo while reading together.
misconceptions.feedback: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Says /l/ for /r/ or /r/ for /l/ while reading (urafiki read as ulafiki).

example.question: Neno "urafiki" linatamkwa vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The first language of the child does not separate these sounds, so the reading carries the home sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "urafiki" linatamkwa vipi?" with "ulafiki" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make a list of the passage words with the hard sound; practise them before reading the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Tamka "urafiki" kama lilivyoandikwa; "ulafiki" ni neno jingine au si neno.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Thinks the voice should stay the same through a happy and a sad part.

example.question: Unasoma sehemu ya huzuni katika hadithi. Sauti yako iweje?
example.correct_answer: ya chini na polepole kuonyesha huzuni

misconceptions.cause: Fluent reading has been taught as accuracy and pace, not feeling.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unasoma sehemu ya huzuni katika hadithi. Sauti yako iweje?" with "sawa na sehemu ya furaha" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read one happy and one sad line; the class names the feeling heard.
misconceptions.feedback: Sauti hubadilika kulingana na hisia za matini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi (Theme 3: Mahusiano)
learning_experiences: kutambua aina mbalimbali za maandishi ya tarakilishi (k.v. chapa koza, italiki na maandishi yaliyopigiwa mstari) akishirikiana na wenzake.
kutambua ishara zinazotumiwa kutofautisha maandishi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kuandika kwa ubunifu kwenye tarakilishi kifungu cha aya moja ya maneno yasiyopungua 50 kuhusu mahusiano kati ya watu katika jamii,
kutumia kipanya kuchagua sehemu ya maandishi anayolenga kutofautisha,
kutumia kipanya kuteua ishara anayotaka kutumia kutofautisha maandishi kama vile ishara ya chapa koza, italiki na kupigia mistari,.
kuonyesha ujuzi wa kidijitali kwa kuwatumia wenzake kifungu alichoandika mtandaoni ili wamtolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unajua maandishi ya aina gani yanayotumika katika tarakilishi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotunga vifungu vya maneno na kuviandika kwenye tarakilishi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kuandika.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga na kuandika kifungu.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapowapatia wenzake nafasi ya kutambua ishara zinazotumiwa kutofautisha maandishi kwenye tarakilishi katika kazi ya vikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowaelekeza wenzake katika matumizi ya tarakilishi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza tarakilishi anapoitumia.
sub_strands.pcis:
Kujiendeleza kibinafsi: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji
Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotumia ujuzi wa kidijitali kuwatumia wenzake kifungu alichoandika mtandaoni ili wamtolee maoni.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika kwa vifaa vya kidijitali na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Shughuli za Ujifunzaji Zilizopendekezwa Swali Dadisi

outcomes.text: kutambua aina mbalimbali za maandishi ya tarakilishi na ishara zinazotumiwa katika maandishi ya tarakilishi
kuandika kifungu kifupi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia maandishi mbalimbali yaliyotofautishwa katika tarakilishi
ufurahia utumiaji wa tarakilishi katika kuandika

skills.name: Tambua mitindo ya maandishi ya tarakilishi
skills.mastery: Names the styles of computer writing (herufi nzito, mlazo, saizi) and the actions kuhifadhi and kuchapisha, and does not take herufi kubwa for herufi nzito, in 8 of 10 new items. Typing a short text (outcome b) is a practical task.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 typed and made a word bold.

skills.name: Andika kifungu kwa tarakilishi ukitumia mitindo mbalimbali ya maandishi
skills.mastery: Types a short paragraph on the theme and uses the text styles for a purpose (bold for the title, italics for a foreign or special word, a larger size for the heading, underlining a key word), selecting the text first, and saves it, in 8 of 10 new items or tasks.

prerequisites.reason: Knowing the text styles comes before using them.
Grade 5 typed, corrected and saved a text.

misconceptions.error: Mixes herufi nzito, mlazo, saizi and rangi.

example.question: Herufi zinazoegemea upande huitwa herufi ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child has used the buttons but does not know their names.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Herufi zinazoegemea upande huitwa herufi ___." with "nzito" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Style names among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Herufi nzito zimenenepeshwa, herufi mlazo huegemea upande, saizi ni ukubwa wa herufi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes herufi kubwa or ndogo (capital or small letters) for a style such as herufi nzito.

example.question: Herufi zilizonenepeshwa huitwa herufi ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks big and bold are the same.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Herufi zilizonenepeshwa huitwa herufi ___." with "kubwa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Kubwa among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Herufi kubwa ni za mwanzo wa sentensi na majina. Herufi nzito ni zilizonenepeshwa, zinaweza kuwa ndogo au kubwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes the actions kuhifadhi (save), kuchapisha (print), kufuta (delete) and kufunga (close).

example.question: Kuweka kazi yako salama katika tarakilishi huitwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know what each button does.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kuweka kazi yako salama katika tarakilishi huitwa ___." with "kuchapisha" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Several actions among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kuhifadhi ni kuweka kazi salama. Kuchapisha ni kutoa karatasi. Kufuta huondoa kazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Makes the whole paragraph bold or large so it "looks important", so the title no longer stands out.

example.question: Ni kipi kinafaa kuwa na herufi nzito katika kifungu chako?

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks styles make writing better in general.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kipi kinafaa kuwa na herufi nzito katika kifungu chako?" with "kifungu chote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show a page with everything bold beside one with only the title bold; which title stands out?
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia herufi nzito kwa anwani au neno muhimu tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Clicks a style button without selecting the text first and expects the text above to change.

example.question: Unataka neno "urafiki" liwe la mlazo. Unaanza na nini?

misconceptions.cause: The order (select, then act) is not yet a habit.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unataka neno "urafiki" liwe la mlazo. Unaanza na nini?" with "bonyeza I" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say aloud: "chagua, kisha bonyeza" each time.
misconceptions.feedback: Chagua maandishi kwanza, kisha chagua mtindo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses underlining or colour where the purpose needs italics (a book title, a word from another language).

example.question: Jina la kitabu "Kisima cha Giningi" katika kifungu liandikwe vipi?

misconceptions.cause: All styles look like decoration to the child.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jina la kitabu "Kisima cha Giningi" katika kifungu liandikwe vipi?" with "kwa rangi nyekundu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make a purpose chart: anwani - nzito; jina la kitabu - mlazo; neno muhimu - kupigiwa mstari.
misconceptions.feedback: Majina ya vitabu huandikwa kwa mlazo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Closes after styling without saving the changes, or saves under a new name each time (Kazi1, Kazi2, Kazi3).

example.question: Umebadilisha mitindo ya kifungu ulichohifadhi jana. Ufanye nini kabla ya kufunga?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know the saved copy is the old one until saved again.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Umebadilisha mitindo ya kifungu ulichohifadhi jana. Ufanye nini kabla ya kufunga?" with "funga tu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Change a style, close without saving, reopen: the change is gone.
misconceptions.feedback: Hifadhi kila unapobadilisha kazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes the symbols used in typing (@ for "at" in an email address, # for a number, % for per cent) or types them as words.

example.question: Alama "@" hutumika wapi?

misconceptions.cause: The symbols are on the keyboard but never named.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Alama "@" hutumika wapi?" with "mwishoni mwa sentensi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Match each symbol to where it is used, with an example.
misconceptions.feedback: Alama @ hutumika katika anwani ya baruapepe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Viwakilishi vya Nafsi (Theme 3: Mahusiano)

skills.name: Tambua na tumia viwakilishi vya nafsi
skills.mastery: Picks mimi, wewe, yeye, sisi, ninyi or wao by who speaks, who is spoken to and who is spoken about, and by one or many, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 4 used pronouns of person.

misconceptions.error: Picks the pronoun of another person (wewe for mimi, wao for sisi).

example.question: Juma anamwambia Akinyi, "___ ni rafiki yangu."

misconceptions.cause: The child does not ask who speaks and who is spoken to.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Juma anamwambia Akinyi, "___ ni rafiki yangu."" with "Mimi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence with speaker, listener and the one spoken about, all in the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Aliye anasema ni mimi, aliye anaambiwa ni wewe, anayezungumziwa ni yeye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the singular for many or the plural for one (sisi for mimi, ninyi for wewe).

example.question: Mama anamwambia mtoto, "___ unastahili sifa."

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the person but not the number.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mama anamwambia mtoto, "___ unastahili sifa."" with "Ninyi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence to one child with the plural pronoun among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Wewe ni mmoja, ninyi ni wengi. Mimi ni mmoja, sisi ni wengi.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

misconceptions.error: Uses a different person in the verb from the pronoun (Mimi anasoma, Sisi wanacheza).

example.question: Jaza: Sisi ___ (cheza) mpira.

misconceptions.cause: The child changes the pronoun but keeps the verb of the third person, the form heard most.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Sisi ___ (cheza) mpira." with "wanacheza" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Line up pronoun and prefix pairs: mimi ni-, wewe u-, yeye a-, sisi tu-, nyinyi m-, wao wa-.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiambishi cha kitenzi hupatana na nafsi: sisi tunacheza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the subject pronoun where the object is meant, with no object marker (Mwalimu alisifu mimi).

example.question: Ni ipi ni sahihi?

misconceptions.cause: English puts "me" after the verb; Kiswahili puts -ni- inside the verb.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni sahihi?" with "Mwalimu alisifu mimi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Colour the object marker inside the verb: a-li-ni-sifu.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitenzi hubeba nafsi ya mtendewa ndani yake: alinisifu.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

skills.name: Tambua na tumia viwakilishi viashiria
skills.mastery: Uses a demonstrative that stands alone in place of the noun (Huyu ni rafiki yangu, Hivi ni vitabu), with the right class and number, and tells it from the demonstrative that follows a noun, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 4 used huyu/yule as pronouns.

misconceptions.error: Uses the demonstrative of another noun class (Hiki ni mti).

example.question: ___ ni mti wa mwembe.

misconceptions.cause: The child has learned one form and uses it for every noun.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "___ ni mti wa mwembe." with "Hii" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A gap with several classes among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiwakilishi kiashiria hufuata ngeli ya kitu kinachoonyeshwa: mti, huu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the singular demonstrative for many or the plural for one (Hawa ni mtoto).

example.question: ___ ni vitabu vya shule.

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the class but not the number.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "___ ni vitabu vya shule." with "Hiki" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A plural noun with the singular form among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitu kimoja: hiki. Vitu vingi: hivi.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

misconceptions.error: Takes the demonstrative after a noun (kitabu hiki) for the pronoun that stands alone (Hiki ni kitabu).

example.question: Chagua sentensi yenye kiwakilishi kiashiria (kinasimama peke yake).

misconceptions.cause: The child sees the word hiki and does not look at whether a noun comes before it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi yenye kiwakilishi kiashiria (kinasimama peke yake)." with "Kitabu hiki ni kizuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two sentences with the same word, one with a noun before it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiwakilishi husimama mahali pa nomino. Kikifuata nomino, ni kivumishi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the near one (huyu, hiki) for something far or already mentioned (yule, kile).

example.question: Unaonyesha mti ulio mbali mlimani. Unasema?

misconceptions.cause: The near form is the default the child uses for everything.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unaonyesha mti ulio mbali mlimani. Unasema?" with "Huu ni mrefu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Point near and far while saying the pairs aloud.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitu kilicho mbali huonyeshwa kwa yule, ule, kile.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

skills.name: Tambua na tumia viwakilishi vya idadi
skills.mastery: Uses a number word on its own in place of the noun (Wawili walichelewa, Vitatu nilimpa Wanjiru) with the prefix of the noun left out of the sentence, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Pronouns that stand for people come first.

misconceptions.error: Uses the number with the prefix of another class (Viwili walichelewa for wawili).

example.question: Wanafunzi kumi walifika. ___ walichelewa. (wawili kati yao)

misconceptions.cause: The child forgets the pronoun takes the prefix of the noun it replaces.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wanafunzi kumi walifika. ___ walichelewa. (wawili kati yao)" with "Viwili" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence about people with the form for things among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiwakilishi cha idadi huchukua kiambishi cha nomino iliyoachwa: watu, wawili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the bare number (Tatu, Wili) with no prefix.

example.question: Nilinunua vitabu vitano. ___ nilimpa Wanjiru. (vitatu kati yake)

misconceptions.cause: In English the number never changes.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Nilinunua vitabu vitano. ___ nilimpa Wanjiru. (vitatu kati yake)" with "Tatu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with the bare number word.
misconceptions.feedback: Nambari moja hadi tano huchukua kiambishi cha nomino, hata ikisimama peke yake.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue influence on Kiswahili (to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher)

misconceptions.error: Adds a prefix to six, seven, nine or ten (Wasita walifika).

example.question: Jaza: (watu 6) ___ walichelewa.

misconceptions.cause: The child applies the prefix rule of one to five to every number.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: (watu 6) ___ walichelewa." with "Wasita" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort number cards: with a prefix (1-5, 8) and without (6, 7, 9, 10).
misconceptions.feedback: Sita, saba, tisa na kumi hazichukui kiambishi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the number pronoun the right prefix but the verb another one (Vitatu wamepotea).

example.question: Jaza: (vitabu 3) Vitatu ___ potea.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks of things lost by people and uses wa-.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: (vitabu 3) Vitatu ___ potea." with "wamepotea" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The verb agrees with the noun the pronoun stands for: vitabu -> vi-.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitenzi hupatana na nomino inayowakilishwa: vitatu vimepotea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Uakifishi (Theme 3: Mahusiano)
learning_experiences: kutambua alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni katika maandishi,
kuakifisha sentensi akitumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni,
kuakifisha kifungu kifupi akitumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni,
kuandika sentensi akitumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni ifaavyo katika daftari lake,
kuandika sentensi zenye alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali.
key_inquiry_questions: Kwa nini alama za kuakifisha hutumiwa katika maandishi?
Ni alama gani za uakifishi unazoweza kuzitumia kwa usahihi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: wanafunzi wanaposhiriki mijadala kuhusu uakifishi.
Ubunifu: wanapotunga sentensi wakitumia viakifishi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoweza kuakifisha sentensi au vifungu ifaavyo.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu mchango wa wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji
Mahusiano ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni akirejelea suala lengwa.
Mawasiliano faafu: mwanafunzi anapotumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni katika maandishi ili kuwasiliana ipasavyo.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya uakifishaji na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji dhana hiyo katika somo la English.

outcomes.text: kutambua alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni katika maandishi
kutumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni ifaavyo katika maandishi
kufurahia matumizi ya alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni katika maandishi

skills.name: Tumia alama ya hisi, ritifaa na koloni
skills.mastery: Chooses the sentence with the right alama ya hisi (!), ritifaa (') as in ng'ombe, and koloni (:) before a list, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 used capitals, commas, full stops and question marks.

misconceptions.error: Ends an exclamation or a command with a full stop or a question mark.

example.question: Lo! Umefika mapema leo!

misconceptions.cause: The child ends every sentence the same way.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Lo! Umefika mapema leo!" with "Lo. Umefika mapema leo." among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence of surprise with a full stop among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Mshangao, furaha na amri kali huisha kwa alama ya hisi (!).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes ng'ombe or ng'ambo without the ritifaa (ngombe).

example.question: Mkulima ana ng'ombe watano.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know the ritifaa marks that ng is one sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mkulima ana ng'ombe watano." with "Mkulima ana ngombe watano." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with the word spelt both ways.
misconceptions.feedback: Ritifaa (') huandikwa baada ya ng katika ng'ombe, ng'ambo, ng'ang'ana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts a comma or a full stop where a koloni goes before a list.

example.question: Mama alinunua vitu hivi: mchele, sukari na chumvi.
example.wrong_answer: Mama alinunua vitu hivi, mchele, sukari na chumvi.
example.correct_answer: Mama alinunua vitu hivi: mchele, sukari na chumvi.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know koloni introduces a list.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mama alinunua vitu hivi: mchele, sukari na chumvi." with "Mama alinunua vitu hivi, mchele, sukari na chumvi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence that announces a list with a comma among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Koloni (:) huja kabla ya orodha au maelezo yanayofuata.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the ritifaa in the wrong place (n'gombe, ngo'mbe).

example.question: Ni ipi imeandikwa sawa?

misconceptions.cause: The child knows a mark goes somewhere in the word but not that it sits right after ng.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi imeandikwa sawa?" with "n'gombe" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The ritifaa marks the sound ng' as one sound: write ng' first, then the rest.
misconceptions.feedback: Ritifaa hukaa baada ya ng: ng'ombe, ng'ambo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo (Theme 4: Misimu)
learning_experiences: kutambua maneno ya heshima (k.v. shehe, kasisi, padre, mwadhini, mheshimiwa, rais, mtawa) kwenye ubao, mti maneno, tarakilishi au kapu maneno,
kueleza maana ya maneno lengwa kama yanavyotumiwa katika mahusiano ya kila siku kati ya watu,
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia maneno lengwa kwa usahihi,
kutazama maigizo ya watu wakitumia maneno ya heshima kwenye tarakilishi na video,
kuigiza mazungumzo mafupi akiwa na wenzake huku akitumia msamiati wa heshima.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni maneno yapi ya heshima unayoyajua na unayoweza kutumia kurejelea watu tofauti?
Kutumia maneno ya heshima kuna umuhimu gani katika jamii?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi, video na projekta kutazama maigizo mafupi.
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika maigizo na mijadala.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoigiza ipasavyo mazungumzo akitumia msamiati wa heshima.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya udugu. Pia anapoheshimu nafasi za wenzake katika maigizo.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya udugu kwa wenzake na kwa wakubwa wake.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya heshima kuwarejelea watu maalum.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika maigizo mafupi akiwa na wenzake.
Masuala ya kiuana na jinsia: mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno yanayorejelea uana na jinsia mahususi katika mawasiliano.
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kwa kuejelea suala lengwa.
Kujiendeleza kibinafsi: mwanafunzi anapotambua maneno ya heshima yanayotumika katika jamii yake kutoka kwa mzazi au mlezi.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha matumizi ya maneno ya heshima, adabu na vyeo na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la misimu na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Enviromental Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua maneno ya heshima yanayotumiwa katika mawasiliano
kuonyesha uelewa wa maneno ya heshima kwa kuyatumia kwa usahihi katika mawasiliano
kuthamini kutumia maneno ya heshima katika mawasiliano ya kila siku

skills.name: Tambua na tumia maneno ya heshima
skills.mastery: Picks the polite word the situation needs (tafadhali to ask, asante to thank, samahani to say sorry, pole to comfort, karibu to welcome, shikamoo to greet an elder) and the sentence that is polite, in 8 of 10 new items. Using the words in daily talk (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 kinship words of respect.

misconceptions.error: Uses a polite word for the wrong job (asante to ask, pole to thank).

example.question: Ukimwomba mwalimu kalamu unasema, "Mwalimu, nipe kalamu, ___."

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the words but not what each is for.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ukimwomba mwalimu kalamu unasema, "Mwalimu, nipe kalamu, ___."" with "asante" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A situation with all the polite words among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Tafadhali ni kuomba, asante ni kushukuru, samahani ni kuomba msamaha, pole ni kufariji, karibu ni kukaribisha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks the sentence without a polite word, as if a command were polite.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina heshima zaidi?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not notice the tone of a command.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ina heshima zaidi?" with "Nisaidie kubeba mzigo huu!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A request with and without tafadhali or naomba.
misconceptions.feedback: Ombi la heshima lina maneno kama tafadhali, naomba, samahani na asante.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Calls an official by the wrong title (Mwalimu for the chief, Daktari for the nurse) or by name only.

example.question: Unamsalimu chifu wa eneo lenu. Unasema?

misconceptions.cause: The child uses the one title he uses every day (mwalimu).
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unamsalimu chifu wa eneo lenu. Unasema?" with "Habari mwalimu?" among the options.
misconceptions.help: List people and their titles: Chifu, Mheshimiwa (MP), Daktari, Muuguzi, Askari.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia cheo sahihi: Bwana Chifu, Mheshimiwa, Daktari.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses wewe and the singular to an elder where the respectful plural is expected in some communities (Shikamooni / nyinyi).

example.question: Unawasalimu wazee wawili. Unasema?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know the plural form of the respectful greeting.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unawasalimu wazee wawili. Unasema?" with "Shikamoo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise Shikamooni for many elders; Marahabani is the reply.
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa wazee wengi tunasema "Shikamooni".
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 4: Misimu)
learning_experiences: kujadili na wenzake kuhusu hatua za kiusalama na maadili anayofaa kuzingatia anapotafuta na kusoma matini ya kidijitali,
kujadili na wenzake kuhusu utunzaji wa vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia katika usomaji,
kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama katika kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali (k.v. kufungua mitandao ifaayo),
kutambua jina la faili lengwa kwenye tarakilishi na kufanya mazoezi ya kufungua na kufunga faili,
kutambua mitandao salama yenye matini inayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake,
kutambua umuhimu wa kutoa habari kwa mwalimu, mzazi au mlezi wake endapo atapata ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandaoni na kutowasiliana nao,
kusoma matini yanayojumuisha msamiati wa misimu kwa kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali,
kutafuta maana za maneno mapyakwenye kamusi mtandaoni,
kusikiliza matamshi na maelezo kuhusu anachokisoma mtandaoni panapowezekana,
kutoa habari kwa muhtasari kuhusu matini aliyosoma na kujibu maswali katika maandishi au mazungumzo na wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Kusoma matini ya kidijitali kuna manufaa gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kiteknolojia katika kutafuta, kusakura na kusoma.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi atapata hamu ya kutafuta matini za kusoma kwenye tarakilishi na mitandaoni.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunzaji vifaa vya kidijitali na kuzingatia mitandao salama.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapojumuika na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapowaruhusu wenzake kutoa maoni na kuheshimu maoni wanayotoa.
sub_strands.pcis:
Usalama wa mitandaoni: mwanafunzi anapozingatia hatua za kiusalama katika kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali.
Kujiendeleza kibinafsi: mwanafunzi anapotafuta maana za maneno mapya kwenye kamusi mtandaoni.
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anaposoma matini kuhusu misimu.
Udhibiti wa uwezo wa kutokea maafa: mwanafunzi anaposoma vifungu kuhusu mazingira na tabia nchi na namna yanavyoweza kusababisha maafa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa mapana na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la misimu na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Enviromental Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua hatua za kiusalama katika matumiziya vifaa vya kidijitali anaposoma
kusakura matini kwenye tovuti salama ili kupata vifungu vya kusoma vyenye mada lengwa
kutumia vifaa ya kidijitali kwa urahisi ili kupata matini yanayolengwa
kuchangamkia matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutafuta na kusoma ujumbe ili kuimarisha maarifa yake

skills.name: Zingatia hatua za kiusalama unapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali
skills.mastery: Chooses the safe step when reading on a phone, tablet or computer (use a site an adult or teacher suggested, keep the password secret, ask an adult before an unknown link, log out) and not the unsafe one, in 8 of 10 new situations. Searching and opening a file (outcomes b and c) is a practical task for the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 safety on digital devices.

skills.name: Fungua faili, sakura kwenye tovuti salama na usome matini ya kidijitali
skills.mastery: Opens a saved file with the passage (finds the folder, double-clicks the file), searches a safe site with two or three key words, ignores pop-ups and adverts, and reads the passage for its message, in 8 of 10 new items or tasks.

prerequisites.reason: Safety on a digital device comes first.
Grade 5 searched and read digital texts.

misconceptions.error: Shares a password or a personal detail with a friend or a stranger.

example.question: Ni hatua ipi ya kiusalama?

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks sharing is friendly.
misconceptions.reveals: Safe and unsafe steps for a password.
misconceptions.help: Ask who can use your account if they have the password.
misconceptions.feedback: Nenosiri ni siri yako. Usimpe mtu mwingine, hata rafiki, ila mzazi au mlezi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Opens every link in a message from someone he does not know.

example.question: Ujumbe usiojulikana una kiungo cha zawadi. Ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child is curious and likes a prize.
misconceptions.reveals: An unknown message with a link.
misconceptions.help: Ask who sent it and whether you asked for it.
misconceptions.feedback: Viungo kutoka kwa watu usiowajua vinaweza kuwa hatari. Mwonyeshe mtu mzima kabla ya kuvifungua.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Searches on any site and gives details to a site that asks for them.

example.question: Unatafuta kifungu cha kusoma. Utumie tovuti ipi?
example.wrong_answer: Tovuti inayotaka jina na nambari ya simu yangu
example.correct_answer: Tovuti ya shule au maktaba iliyopendekezwa na mwalimu

misconceptions.cause: The child does not ask who runs the site.
misconceptions.reveals: Safe and unsafe sites.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the site needs your personal details to read.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia tovuti salama zilizopendekezwa na mwalimu au mzazi, na usitoe maelezo yako binafsi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes up a folder and a file: looks for the passage on the screen without opening the folder it is in.

example.question: Kifungu "Misimu ya Kenya" kimehifadhiwa ndani ya folda "Kiswahili". Utakifunguaje?
example.wrong_answer: bonyeza "Misimu ya Kenya" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo
example.correct_answer: fungua folda "Kiswahili", kisha bonyeza mara mbili faili "Misimu ya Kenya"

misconceptions.cause: The child has only used apps on a phone, where there are no folders.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kifungu "Misimu ya Kenya" kimehifadhiwa ndani ya folda "Kiswahili". Utakifunguaje?" with "bonyeza "Misimu ya Kenya" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show a real folder (a box file) holding papers; then the same on the screen.
misconceptions.feedback: Faili huhifadhiwa ndani ya folda; fungua folda kwanza, kisha faili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Types a whole long question, with spelling mistakes, into the search box.

example.question: Unatafuta habari kuhusu misimu. Utaandika nini kwenye kisanduku cha kutafutia?
example.wrong_answer: naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu misimu tafadhali

misconceptions.cause: The child talks to the search box as to a person.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unatafuta habari kuhusu misimu. Utaandika nini kwenye kisanduku cha kutafutia?" with "naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu misimu tafadhali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the two or three words that carry the meaning; search with those; compare the results.
misconceptions.feedback: Andika maneno mawili au matatu muhimu tu, na uyaandike kwa tahajia sahihi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Clicks a pop-up or an advert that says he has won a prize.

example.question: Ukiwa unasoma, ujumbe unatokea: "Umeshinda simu! Bonyeza hapa." Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: usibonyeze; funga ujumbe na umwambie mwalimu au mzazi

misconceptions.cause: Offers of prizes are exciting and the child does not know they are traps.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ukiwa unasoma, ujumbe unatokea: "Umeshinda simu! Bonyeza hapa." Ufanye nini?" with "bonyeza ili kupokea simu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show two screenshots, one real page and one trap; the child finds three signs of the trap.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe wa zawadi usiotarajiwa ni mtego; usiubonyeze.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses any site that comes up and gives his name, school or phone number when a site asks.

example.question: Tovuti inakuuliza jina lako kamili, shule yako na nambari ya simu ya mzazi kabla ya kusoma hadithi. Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: usijaze; tumia tovuti salama aliyokupa mwalimu

misconceptions.cause: The child wants the story and does not see personal details as worth protecting.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tovuti inakuuliza jina lako kamili, shule yako na nambari ya simu ya mzazi kabla ya kusoma hadithi. Ufanye nini?" with "jaza ili usome hadithi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: List the details that are private; practise saying no to a form.
misconceptions.feedback: Usimpe mtu yeyote mtandaoni jina lako kamili, shule yako wala nambari ya simu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the steps of finding and reading a passage in the wrong order (reads before searching, or searches before switching on).

example.question: Ni hatua ipi huja kwanza?

misconceptions.cause: The child has watched an adult do the steps quickly and remembers the parts, not the order.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni hatua ipi huja kwanza?" with "andika maneno ya kutafutia" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Step cards: the child orders them, then does them on a real device.
misconceptions.feedback: Washa kifaa, fungua kivinjari, andika maneno muhimu, chagua tovuti salama, soma.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Believes and shares whatever he reads online without checking the source.

example.question: Unaona ujumbe mtandaoni: "Shule zote zitafungwa kesho!" Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: uthibitishe kwa mwalimu au tovuti rasmi kabla ya kuamini

misconceptions.cause: The child trusts anything written on a screen.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unaona ujumbe mtandaoni: "Shule zote zitafungwa kesho!" Ufanye nini?" with "uwatumie marafiki wote haraka" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Check one rumour together on an official site.
misconceptions.feedback: Thibitisha habari kwa chanzo rasmi kabla ya kuamini au kusambaza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Barua Rasmi (Theme 4: Misimu)
learning_experiences: kutambua barua rasmi kwenye kielelezo cha barua rasmi iliyochapishwa au kwenye tarakilishi,

kujadili vipengele vya barua rasmi (k.v. anwani ya mwandishi [jina, sanduku la posta, tarehe], anwani ya mpokeaji [cheo, sanduku la posta], mtajo, mada ya barua, mwili, hitimisho, sahihi na jina la mwandishi),

kuandika barua rasmi kwa mwalimu akiomba kujiunga na klabu shuleni(k.v. vile skauti, mazingira,kilimo na muziki), akishirikiana na wenzake darasani, kwa hati za mkono au kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali akizingatia muundowa uandishi wa barua rasmi,
kuandika barua rasmi katika daftariakiwa peke yake,
kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu umuhimu wa barua rasmi katikamawasiliano.
key_inquiry_questions: Barua rasmi ni barua ya aina gani
Unazingatia nini unapoandika baruarasmi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili barua rasmi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga na kuandika barua rasmi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapoandika barua kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: anapowaza kuhusu kanuni za barua rasmi na kupanga aya.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji kama kujadili vipengele vya barua rasmi.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapozingatia maoni ya wenzake wakati wa mijadala.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapoandika barua rasmi kama anavyoagizwa.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mawasiliano faafu: mwanafunzi anapotumia barua rasmi kuwasiliana.
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya barua rasmi kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotekeleza shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake darasani.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika barua rasmi na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la misimu na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Enviromental Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua barua rasmi kwa kuzingatia muundo wake
kutambua vipengele vya barua rasmi ili kuvizingatia katika uandishi
kuandika barua rasmi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo
kuchangamkia umuhimu wa barua rasmi katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua muundo na vipengele vya barua rasmi
skills.mastery: Names the parts of a barua rasmi (anwani ya mwandikaji kulia, tarehe, anwani ya mwandikiwa kushoto, salamu, kichwa, mwili, mwisho "Wako mwaminifu", sahihi na jina) and tells it from a friendly letter, in 8 of 10 new items. Writing the letter (outcome c) is composition marking.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
The formal parts of an email prepare for an official letter.

skills.name: Andika barua rasmi kwa muundo na lugha ifaayo
skills.mastery: Tells barua rasmi from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes an official letter with two addresses, the date, a formal greeting, a KUH: line, the message and Wako mtiifu with a signature; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: The parts of an official letter come before writing one.
Grade 5 wrote emails with a subject line and formal closing.

misconceptions.error: Puts a part of the letter in the wrong place (salamu for kichwa, tarehe for jina).

example.question: Mada ya barua rasmi huandikwa katika ___ cha barua.

misconceptions.cause: The child has met the parts but not what each holds.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mada ya barua rasmi huandikwa katika ___ cha barua." with "mwili" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Parts asked by what they hold.
misconceptions.feedback: Kichwa hutaja mada, salamu humwamkia mwandikiwa, mwili una ujumbe, na mwisho una sahihi na jina.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the sender's address on the left and the receiver's on the right.

example.question: Anwani ya mwandikaji wa barua rasmi huandikwa upande wa ___ juu ya karatasi.

misconceptions.cause: The child swaps the two addresses.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Anwani ya mwandikaji wa barua rasmi huandikwa upande wa ___ juu ya karatasi." with "kushoto" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Left and right among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani ya mwandikaji iko juu kulia. Anwani ya mwandikiwa iko kushoto, chini ya tarehe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the greeting, ending or words of a friendly letter in a formal one.

example.question: Mwisho wa barua rasmi huwa "Wako ___,".

misconceptions.cause: The child writes to a headteacher as to a friend.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwisho wa barua rasmi huwa "Wako ___,"." with "mpenzi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A formal and a friendly ending among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha na maneno ya heshima, kama "Wako mwaminifu,".
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the parts of the letter in the wrong order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi sahihi wa sehemu za barua rasmi?
example.wrong_answer: Salamu, mwili, anwani, kichwa, tarehe, mwisho
example.correct_answer: Anwani, tarehe, salamu, kichwa, mwili, mwisho

misconceptions.cause: The child does not picture the page from top to bottom.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi sahihi wa sehemu za barua rasmi?" with "Salamu, mwili, anwani, kichwa, tarehe, mwisho" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two orderings among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua huanza na anwani na tarehe juu, kisha salamu, kichwa, mwili na mwisho chini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes only one address, or puts the receiver's address at the top right.

example.question: Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?
example.correct_answer: mbili: ya mwandishi (kulia juu) na ya mpokeaji (kushoto)

misconceptions.cause: The friendly letter has one address and the child carries it over.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?" with "moja, ya mwandishi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Label both addresses on a model; the child writes his own and the receiver's on a blank layout.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi ina anwani mbili: ya mwandishi kulia juu, ya mpokeaji kushoto chini yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out the subject line (KUH: or YAH:) or writes it as a long sentence.

example.question: Ni kichwa kipi kinafaa katika barua rasmi kuhusu ombi la kupanda miti shuleni?
example.wrong_answer: Nimeandika barua hii kwa sababu ninataka kukueleza mambo mengi.
example.correct_answer: KUH: OMBI LA KUPANDA MITI SHULENI

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know the reader of an official letter needs the subject before reading.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kichwa kipi kinafaa katika barua rasmi kuhusu ombi la kupanda miti shuleni?" with "Nimeandika barua hii kwa sababu ninataka kukueleza mambo mengi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the KUH: line on three real letters; it is short and in capitals.
misconceptions.feedback: Kichwa cha barua rasmi huanza KUH: au YAH: na huandikwa kwa herufi kubwa, kwa ufupi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses friendly words in an official letter (Mpendwa rafiki, Hujambo?, Wako akupendaye).

example.question: Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa Mwalimu Mkuu?

misconceptions.cause: The friendly letter is the first letter learnt and its words come first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa Mwalimu Mkuu?" with "Hujambo mwalimu wangu mpendwa!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort salamu and closing cards into "kirafiki" and "rasmi".
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha rasmi: Kwa Mwalimu Mkuu, Wako mtiifu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends with only a first name and no signature, or with "Ni mimi rafiki yako".

example.question: Barua rasmi humalizika vipi?
example.correct_answer: Wako mtiifu, sahihi, na jina kamili: Wanjiku Kamau

misconceptions.cause: The friendly closing is a habit.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Barua rasmi humalizika vipi?" with "Ni mimi rafiki yako, Wanjiku" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Model the closing block (Wako mtiifu, sahihi, jina kamili) and have the child copy it once.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi humalizika kwa "Wako mtiifu," sahihi na jina kamili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ngeli ya YA-YA (Theme 4: Misimu)
learning_experiences: kutambua viambishi vya ngeli ya YA-YA katika sentensi kwa kuvipigia mstari au kuvikoleza rangi katika tarakilishi,
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya YA-YA kutokana na upatanisho wa kisarufi kwenye sentensi (k.m. maji, maziwa, mate, marashi na maskani),
kuandika nomino katika ngeli ya YA-YA katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutunga sentensi sahihi kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA-YA kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unajua majina gani ya vitu visivyohesabika?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anashirikiana na wenzake.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotumia nomino za ngeli ya YA-YA ipasavyo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua nomino na ngeli zake.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wenzake kwa kushirikiana na wenzake
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Mawasiliano faafu: mwanafunzi anapowasiliana kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA- YA katika umoja na wingi ifaavyo.
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA- YA katika umoja na wingi ifaavyo zinazohusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya sarufi na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la misimu na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Enviromental Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya YA – YA katika sentensi
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya YA-YA kutokana na upatanisho wa kisarufi
kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA –YA katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi
kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya YA-YA katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia ngeli ya YA-YA kwa upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Knows nouns that belong to YA-YA (maji, maziwa, mafuta, mate, machozi, manukato; they begin with ma- and have no singular), gives ya- as the subject prefix, and does not use li- or a prefix of another class, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses li- with a ma- noun because it starts with ma- (maji limeisha).

example.question: Maji ___meisha kisimani.

misconceptions.cause: The child learned that ma- goes with li-, which is true only for the plural of nouns that have a singular.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maji ___meisha kisimani." with "li" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Je, kuna neno jiji, au jimaji?" Maji has no singular.
misconceptions.feedback: Maji ni ya ngeli ya YA-YA. Hupatana na ya-: maji yameisha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses u-, i-, zi- or vi- with a YA-YA noun.

example.question: Maziwa ___meichacha jikoni.

misconceptions.cause: The child uses the prefix of the class he knows best.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maziwa ___meichacha jikoni." with "i" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A gap with several prefixes among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za YA-YA hupatana na ya- tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses a- as for a person or animal (maziwa ameichacha).

example.question: Maziwa ___meichacha jikoni.

misconceptions.cause: The child treats the noun like a living thing.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maziwa ___meichacha jikoni." with "a" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A gap with a- among the options for a thing noun.
misconceptions.feedback: A- ni ya watu na wanyama. Maziwa ni kitu, na hupatana na ya-.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a noun of another class as a YA-YA noun.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya YA-YA?

misconceptions.cause: The child cannot yet tell YA-YA nouns by their agreement.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya YA-YA?" with "kitabu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with nouns from different classes.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za YA-YA hupatana na ya- na hazina umoja, kama maji.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Methali Kufikia mwisho wa (Theme 5: Mshikamano wa kitaifa)
learning_experiences: kutambua methali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano (kama vile; umoja ni nguvu utengano ni udhaifu, jifya moja haliinjikichungu, kidole kimoja hakivunji chawa, kinga na kinga ndio moto huwaka n.k.) katika chati, ubao na vyombo vyakidijitali,
kutoa mifano ya methali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano katika jamii,
kusikiliza methali za umoja na ushirikiano zikitumiwa kupitia vyombo vya kidijitali,
kujadili na wenzake maana na matumizi ya methali mbalimbali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano,
kulinganisha methali na maana yake,
kukamilisha methali mbalimbali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano katika mazungumzo akishirikiana na wenzake, kwenye daftari au kwa kutumia vyombo vya kidijitali,
kusakura mtandaoni kwa kusaidiwa na mzazi au mlezi wake ili kupata methali zaidi zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano na matumizi ya methali hizo,
kujadili na wenzake kuhusu methali alizozipata mtandaoni ili wajengane kimaarifa.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni nini umuhimu wa methali katika jamii?
Ni methali gani unazozijua kuhusu umoja na ushirikiano?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kujadili methali kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu matumizi ya methali.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotumia methali kujieleza.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutambua methali.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anachangamkia maoni ya wenzake.
Umoja: wanafunzi wanapofanya kazi katika vikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii na utaifa: mwanafunzi anapokamilisha methali mbalimbali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano katika mazungumzo akishirikiana na wenzake.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake.
Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza methali za umoja na ushirikiano zikitumiwa kupitia vyombo vya kidijitali
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya matumizi ya methali na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la mshikamano wa kitaifa na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies. Shughuli za Ujifunzaji Zilizopendekezwa Swali Dadisi
sub_strands.design_notes: Second read left this for a person to confirm: no lessons figure.

outcomes.text: kutambua methali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano katika matini
kueleza maana na matumizi ya methali mbalimbali zinazohusu umoja naushirikiano katika jamii
kutumia methali zinazohusu umoja na ushirikiano katika mawasiliano
kuchangamkia matumizi ya methalizinazohimiza umoja na ushirikiano

skills.name: Tambua na eleza maana ya methali za umoja na ushirikiano
skills.mastery: Completes a methali about unity and working together (umoja ni nguvu, kidole kimoja hakivunji chawa, mkono mmoja haulei mwana, wengi wape) and says what it means, and does not read it word for word, in 8 of 10 new items. Using a methali when speaking (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 methali on hard work.

misconceptions.error: Reads the methali word for word.

example.question: Mchumia juani hulia kivulini. Maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: Anayefanya kazi kwa bidii hufurahia matunda yake baadaye

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know that a methali carries a second meaning.
misconceptions.reveals: A meaning question with a literal option.
misconceptions.help: Ask what lesson the methali teaches.
misconceptions.feedback: Methali haisemi maana yake wazi. Mchumia juani hulia kivulini ina maana kwamba anayefanya kazi kwa bidii atapumzika na kufurahia matunda yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the lesson of another methali.

example.question: Haba na haba hujaza kibaba. Maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: Vitu vidogo vikiongezwa polepole huwa vingi

misconceptions.cause: The child knows methali but swaps their lessons.
misconceptions.reveals: The meaning of a different methali as an option.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the words say about little and little.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila methali ina funzo lake. Haba na haba hujaza kibaba inafundisha kwamba kidogo kidogo hujaza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Completes the methali with a word that does not belong to it.

example.question: Haba na haba hujaza ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the beginning but not the end.
misconceptions.reveals: A gap where a plausible wrong ending is an option.
misconceptions.help: Say the whole methali again from the beginning.
misconceptions.feedback: Methali hubaki jinsi ilivyo. Mwisho sahihi ni kibaba: haba na haba hujaza kibaba.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the opposite lesson (Kidole kimoja hakivunji chawa: one person is enough).

example.question: Maana ya "Kidole kimoja hakivunji chawa" ni?
example.wrong_answer: mtu mmoja anaweza kufanya kazi yote

misconceptions.cause: The child reads "hakivunji" quickly and misses the negative.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maana ya "Kidole kimoja hakivunji chawa" ni?" with "mtu mmoja anaweza kufanya kazi yote" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the methali slowly and mark the negative word; say what one finger cannot do.
misconceptions.feedback: Methali hii inafunza ushirikiano: mtu mmoja hawezi peke yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 5: Mshikamano wa kitaifa)
learning_experiences: kujadili ukwapi na utao katika shairi,
kutambua ukwapi na utao katika shairi kwenye ubao, chati, vitabu au vyombo vya kidijitali,
kusoma shairi akizingatia ukwapi na utao,
kujirekodi akisoma aina za mashairi lengwa akitumia vyombo vya kidijitali ili kuweza kujirekebisha anakokosea,
kutofautisha mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia kwenye ubao, chati, vitabu au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kutambua mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia katika matini mbalimbali,
kusoma mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia kwa mahadhi mbalimbali,
kujadili ujumbe kwenye shairi waliyoyasoma,
kujibu maswali yanayotokana na mashairi aliyoyasoma,
kuandika ujumbe alioupata katika mojawapo ya mashairi aliyoyasoma na kuujadili na wenzake darasani.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, kuna tofauti gani kati ya mashairi mbalimbali?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili aina lengwa za mashairi.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotafakari kuhusu ujumbe wa mashairi aliyosoma mtandaoni.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoweza kusoma mashairi kwa mahadhi yafaayo. Pia anapoweza kufafanua ipasavyo ujumbe wa shairi alilolisoma.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutambua aina za shairi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anachangamkia maoni ya wenzake.
Umoja: wanafunzi wanapofanya kazi katika vikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii na utaifa: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake.
Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni ili kusoma mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia katika matini mbalimbali akisaidiana na mzazi au mlezi.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa ufahamu na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la mshikamano wa kitaifa na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kujadili dhana za ukwapi na utao katika shairi ili kuzibainisha
kutambua mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia kwa kuzingatia muundo
kusoma mashairi ya tathnia, tathlitha na tarbia ili kupata ujumbe
kuchangamkia usomaji wa mashairi ili kuyathamini

skills.name: Tambua aina za mashairi: tathnia, tathlitha, tarbia
skills.mastery: Names the kind of poem by the lines in a stanza (tathnia: two, tathlitha: three, tarbia: four), and names the two parts of a line (ukwapi, the first, and utao, the second), without swapping them or counting mizani instead, in 8 of 10 new items. Reading a poem for its message (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 counted mizani and found vina.

misconceptions.error: Gives the name of another kind of poem for the number of lines (tathlitha for tathnia).

example.question: Ubeti wenye mishororo miwili huitwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child has the names but not the numbers behind them.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ubeti wenye mishororo miwili huitwa ___." with "tathlitha" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The number of lines asked with all three names among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Tathnia ni mishororo miwili, tathlitha mitatu na tarbia minne. Jina linaonyesha idadi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Names the kind of a stanza shown without counting its lines.

example.question: Ubeti huu ni wa aina gani? "Mvua imenyesha, / Mito imejaa."

misconceptions.cause: The child guesses from the look of the stanza.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ubeti huu ni wa aina gani? "Mvua imenyesha, / Mito imejaa."" with "tathlitha" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A short stanza with the three names among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Hesabu mishororo kwanza. Mistari miwili ni tathnia, mitatu ni tathlitha, minne ni tarbia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Swaps ukwapi (the first part of a line) and utao (the second).

example.question: Kipande cha kwanza cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the two names but not their order.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kipande cha kwanza cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___." with "utao" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Both names among the options for the first or the second part.
misconceptions.feedback: Mshororo hugawanyika katika sehemu mbili: ukwapi ni ya kwanza, utao ni ya pili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives vina or mizani for the parts of a line.

example.question: Kipande cha pili cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes the parts of a line with its sounds and counts.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kipande cha pili cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___." with "vina" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with vina and mizani.
misconceptions.feedback: Vina ni sauti za mwisho zinazofanana, na mizani ni silabi. Vipande vya mshororo ni ukwapi na utao.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Maelezo (Theme 5: Mshikamano wa kitaifa)
