learning_experiences: kutambua vifungu vya maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,
kujadili vidokezo vya insha ya maelezo atakavyovitumia katika kuandika insha yake,

kuonyesha umilisi wa ubunifu kwa kuandika insha ya maelezo (k.v. Siku ya sherehe ya kitaifa, Siku ya michezo ya kitaifa, Nchi yetu, n.k) isiyopungua maneno 200 akizingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na lugha ya kiubunifu inayojumuisha methali na nahau alizojifunza awali ili kutoa picha dhahiri kuhusu anachokielezea,
kukuza umilisi wa ujuzi wa kidijitali kwa kuandika insha ya maelezo na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Insha ya maelezo ina sifa gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: wanafunzi wanaposhiriki katika mijadala na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: wakati vifaa vya kiteknolojia vinapotumiwa kuandika na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya maelezo
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maswali dadisi yaliyopendekezwa na anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapowajibika kuandika insha ifaavyo.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii na utaifa: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili vigezo na kuandika insha ya maelezo kuhusu suala lengwa na kutekeleza shughuli zingine za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika insha za maelezo na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la mshikamano wa kitaifa na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua insha za maelezo katika matini mbalimbali
kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo
kuchangamkia utunzi bora maishani

skills.name: Tambua insha ya wasifu, masimulizi na maelezo
skills.mastery: Tells a short text that describes a person (wasifu), one that tells events in order (masimulizi) and one that explains how something is done or what it is (maelezo), in 8 of 10 new short texts.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 sorted the kinds of writing.

skills.name: Tambua na andika insha ya maelezo
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes an explanation or description on the topic, in order, with detail that makes a picture and no point off the topic; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Recognising a maelezo comes before writing it.
Grade 5 wrote maelezo in order.

misconceptions.error: Takes a text that describes a person (wasifu) for a story (masimulizi).

example.question: Kifungu kinaelezea sura, tabia na maisha ya mtu. Ni insha ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: Both kinds can mention a person.
misconceptions.reveals: Short texts: one describing a person, one telling events.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the text tells what happened in order, or tells who someone is.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya wasifu humwelezea mtu: sura yake, tabia yake na maisha yake. Masimulizi husimulia matukio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a text that explains how something is done (maelezo) for a story.

example.question: Kifungu kinaeleza hatua za kupika uji. Ni insha ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child sees a sequence in both.
misconceptions.reveals: A recipe-like text and a story.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the writer says "what happened" or "how to do it".
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo au jinsi ya kufanya kitu. Masimulizi husimulia tukio lililotokea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a story of events for a description of a person.

example.question: Kifungu kinasimulia kilichotokea Jumamosi kijijini. Ni insha ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: A story has a person in it.
misconceptions.reveals: A story about a person doing things.
misconceptions.help: Does the text tell events in order?
misconceptions.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio kwa mpangilio. Wasifu humwelezea mtu mwenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should explain or describe.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, tuwakaribishe wanafunzi wapya kutoka jamii zote.

misconceptions.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it is, how it works or is done.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, tuwakaribishe wanafunzi wapya kutoka jamii zote.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni"?" with "Umoja ni mzuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the steps of how to do something in a mixed-up order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni"?
example.wrong_answer: tatua migogoro kwa amani, heshimu tamaduni, shirikiana katika kazi, wakaribishe wageni
example.correct_answer: wakaribishe wageni, shirikiana katika kazi, heshimu tamaduni, tatua migogoro kwa amani

misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the steps as a set, not as a sequence.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni"?" with "tatua migogoro kwa amani, heshimu tamaduni, shirikiana katika kazi, wakaribishe wageni" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out the steps; number them; write them with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
misconceptions.feedback: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, tuwakaribishe wanafunzi wapya kutoka jamii zote.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni" ina sehemu zipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Insha "Jinsi ya Kudumisha Umoja Shuleni" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a maelezo of how to do something for a wasifu, or a wasifu for a maelezo.

example.question: Matini inayoanza "Kwanza, chukua jembe..." ni ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: Both describe; the child does not ask whether it describes a thing or explains how to do something.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Matini inayoanza "Kwanza, chukua jembe..." ni ya aina gani?" with "wasifu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: does it describe how something is (wasifu) or how it is done (maelezo)?
misconceptions.feedback: Maelezo hufafanua jinsi ya kufanya jambo; wasifu hueleza jinsi kitu au mtu alivyo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ngeli ya U-U (Theme 5: Mshikamano wa kitaifa)
learning_experiences: kutambua viambishi vya ngeli ya U-U katika sentensi kwa kuvipigia mstari au kuvikoleza rangi katika tarakilishi,
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya U-U kutokana na upatanisho wa kisarufi kwenye sentensi (k.m: uji, ugali, uhuru, ujanja, urafiki),
kuandika nomino katika ngeli ya U-U katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutunga sentensi sahihi kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya U-U kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni nomino zipi hupatikana katika ngeli ya U-U?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anashirikiana na wenzake.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotambua nomino za ngeli ya U-U ipasavyo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua nomino za ngeli ya U-U.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia.
Uzalendo: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wenzake kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutekeleza shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Mshikamano wa kijamii na utaifa: mwanafunzi anapoandika mafungu ya maneno yenye nomino za ngeli ya U-U katika umoja na wingi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya nomino na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la mshikamano wa kitaifa na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya U - U katika sentensi
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya U - U kutokana na upatanisho wa kisarufi
kutumia nomino za ngeli ya U - U katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi
kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya U-U katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia ngeli ya U-U kwa upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Knows nouns that belong to U-U (uji, unga, ugali, usingizi, uchafu, wino, mchele, mchanga: no plural), gives u- as the subject prefix, and does not use ya- or i-, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
U-YA and U-U both start with u-; telling them apart is the work.

misconceptions.error: Uses ya- or zi- with a U-U noun as if it had a plural (uji yametiwa).

example.question: Uji ___metiwa sukari.

misconceptions.cause: The child assumes every noun can be many.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Uji ___metiwa sukari." with "ya" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Je, tunasema ujiuji? Uji una wingi?" It has none.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za U-U hazina wingi, kwa hiyo hupatana na u- tu: uji umetiwa sukari.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses i-, li- or another prefix with a U-U noun.

example.question: Ugali ___meiva sasa.

misconceptions.cause: The child uses the prefix of a class he knows better.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ugali ___meiva sasa." with "i" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A gap with several prefixes among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za U-U hupatana na u-: ugali umeiva.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a noun of another class as a U-U noun.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya U-U?

misconceptions.cause: The child cannot yet tell U-U nouns by their agreement.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya U-U?" with "kitabu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with nouns from different classes.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za U-U hupatana na u- na hazina wingi, kama uji.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a U-U noun a ma- plural (umoja -> maumoja, uji -> mauji).

example.question: Wingi wa "umoja" ni upi?

misconceptions.cause: U-YA nouns like ugonjwa/magonjwa teach the child that u- nouns take ma-.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "umoja" ni upi?" with "maumoja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Test: can you count it? Umoja, uji, ugali are not counted; they stay U-U.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za U-U hazina wingi: umoja wetu, uji umepikwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Matamshi Bora (Theme 6: Usawa wa kijinsia)
learning_experiences: kusikiliza shairi kuhusu suala lengwa na lenye maneno yenye sauti lengwa (d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng) likikaririwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kukariri akishirikiana na wenzake, shairi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi ya maneno yenye sauti lengwa na mahadhi mbalimbali,
kutamka maneno yaliyoundwa kutokana na sauti d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng katika shairi,
kutambua msamiati uliotumika katika ushairi kuhusu usawa wa kijinsia (k.m. jinsia, ubaguzi, mtoto wa kiume, mtoto wa kike, usawa, heshima na uwajibikaji),
kutumia msamiati uliotumika katika shairi kutunga sentensi sahihi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusakura mtandaoni, akishirikiana na wenzake, ili kukariri au kuimba shairi kwa mahadhi mbalimbali,
kujadili ujumbe katika shairi waliloliimba,
kujibu maswali yanayotokana na shairi alilosikiliza, aliloimba au kukariri,
kusoma mashairi katika vitabu na mtandaoni ili kukuza hamu ya ujifunzaji.
key_inquiry_questions: Kwa nini ni muhimu kuwa na matamshi bora?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anashirikiana na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anasikiliza shairi lililorekodiwa likikaririwa. Pia, anaposakura mtandaoni kupata mashairi zaidi na kuyakariri.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapokariri shairi kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora na mahadhi mbalimbali.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoendelea kusoma mashairi katika vitabu na mtandaoni.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia.
Uzalendo: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wenzake kwa kushirikiana.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutekeleza shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Usawa wa kijinsia: mwanafunzi anapotambua msamiati uliotumika katika ushairi kuhusu usawa wa kijinsia.
Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni, akishirikiana na wenzake, ili kukariri au kuimba shairi kwa mahadhi mbalimbali.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kukariri mashairi na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la usawa wa kijinsia na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studie. Mapendekezo ya Shughuli za Ujifunzaji Maswali Dadisi

outcomes.text: kukariri au kuimba shairi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia, matamshi ya maneno yenye sauti lengwa na mahadhi mbalimbali ili kukuza matamshi bora
kueleza maana ya maneno yenye sauti lengwa yaliyotumika katika shairi
kutumia kwa usahihi msamiati uliotumiwa katika shairi ili kuboresha mawasiliano
kuonyesha ufahamu wa ujumbe katika shairi kwa kujibu maswali
kuchangamkia mahadhi mbalimbali katika ushairi

skills.name: Kariri shairi kwa matamshi bora na ueleze msamiati na ujumbe wake
skills.mastery: Recites or sings a poem on gender equality with clear target sounds and its beat, explains a word of the poem from its line and uses it in a sentence, and answers questions on the message from the poem only, in 8 of 10 new items (the recitation scored by the teacher).

prerequisites.reason: Grade 5 recited a poem and explained its words.
The target sounds of the poem were practised in Theme 1.

misconceptions.error: Says the target sound of the poem as the close sound (nchi as chi, ng'ombe as gombe) while reciting.

example.question: Neno "njia" katika shairi linatamkwa vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The nasal is quick and the child drops it when reciting fast.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "njia" katika shairi linatamkwa vipi?" with "jia" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Slow the line down; say the nasal clearly, then speed up.
misconceptions.feedback: Tamka sauti ya pua wazi: njia, si jia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a line about equal roles literally (both must do the same job every day).

example.question: Shairi linasema: "Kazi ya nyumba si ya mama peke yake." Maana yake ni?
example.correct_answer: wote nyumbani, wake kwa waume, washiriki kazi

misconceptions.cause: The child reads the negative as a rule against the mother.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Shairi linasema: "Kazi ya nyumba si ya mama peke yake." Maana yake ni?" with "mama asifanye kazi ya nyumba" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Restate the line in a positive sentence together.
misconceptions.feedback: Shairi linafunza kwamba kazi ni ya wote.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the everyday meaning of a word where the poem uses a figurative one (bega as the shoulder only, where it means support).

example.question: "Tushikane bega kwa bega." Maana ya "bega kwa bega" ni?

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the body word and does not test it against the line.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Tushikane bega kwa bega." Maana ya "bega kwa bega" ni?" with "kugusa mabega" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the line with each meaning in place; keep the one that makes sense.
misconceptions.feedback: Bega kwa bega hapa ni kushirikiana pamoja kwa usawa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers a question about the poem from his own view, not from the poem.

example.question: Kwa mujibu wa shairi, kwa nini wasichana na wavulana wasome wote?
example.correct_answer: kwa sababu elimu ni haki ya kila mtoto

misconceptions.cause: The topic is one the child has views on.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kwa mujibu wa shairi, kwa nini wasichana na wavulana wasome wote?" with "kwa sababu wazazi wanataka" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask for the line that gives the answer.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu kutokana na maneno ya shairi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 6: Usawa wa kijinsia)
learning_experiences: kueleza umuhimu wa kusoma kwa kina, kujadili mambo ya kuzingatia anapochagua matini za kusoma katika maktaba (k.v. makala yanayoambatana na umri, ukubwa wa maandishi, ujumbe anaotaka kuupata),
kuchagua makala mbalimbali kuhusu suala lengwa katika maktaba (makala yaliyochapishwa au katika kifaa cha kidijitali),
kusoma makala ya aina mbalimbali aliyoyachagua,
kujadiliana kwa heshima na wenzake kuhusu ujumbe alioupata katika makala aliyoyasoma kutumia kamusi kupata maana za msamiati uliotumika katika makala.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, kwa nini ni muhimu kuwa na mazoea ya kusoma makala au hadithi?
Kusoma makala kuhusu usawa wa kijinsia kuna umuhimu gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anaposoma makala katika vifaa vya kidijitali.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposoma makala mbalimbali na kuweza kueleza ujumbe uliomo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu ujumbe uliokatika makala.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutekeleza shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji
Usawa wa kijinsia: mwanafunzi anapochagua makala mbalimbali kuhusu suala lengwa katika maktaba (makala yaliyochapishwa au katika kifaa cha kidijitali).
Mahusiano ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana kwa heshima na wenzake kuhusu ujumbe alioupata katika makala aliyoyasoma.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa mapana na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la usawa wa kijinsia na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studie.

outcomes.text: kujadili mambo ya kuzingatia katika kuchagua makala ya kusoma katika maktaba
kutambua makala atakayosoma katika maktaba
kusoma makala mbalimbali ili kupata ujumbe
kufurahia kusoma makala mbalimbali ilikujenga ufasaha wa lugha

skills.name: Chagua makala maktabani kwa vigezo na uyasome kupata ujumbe
skills.mastery: Chooses an article in the library by what to look for (topic, level, date, author), tells an article from a story or a poem, reads it and gives its message, telling the main point from its examples, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 5 found an article in the library and read it.
Finding the message of a passage.

misconceptions.error: Chooses an article by its length or colour, not by its topic and his reading level.

example.question: Ni kigezo kipi bora cha kuchagua makala maktabani?

misconceptions.cause: Nobody has named the criteria; the child picks what looks impressive.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kigezo kipi bora cha kuchagua makala maktabani?" with "makala marefu zaidi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: List criteria together (mada, kiwango, mwandishi, tarehe) and use them on three real articles.
misconceptions.feedback: Chagua makala kwa mada yake na kiwango cha lugha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Chooses an old article for news that changes (last year's statistics) without looking at the date.

example.question: Unatafuta habari mpya kuhusu usawa wa kijinsia shuleni. Uangalie nini kwanza?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know information goes out of date.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unatafuta habari mpya kuhusu usawa wa kijinsia shuleni. Uangalie nini kwanza?" with "picha ya jalada" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Compare two articles on the same topic from different years.
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa habari mpya, angalia tarehe ya makala.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives an example in the article as its main point.

example.question: Wazo kuu la makala "Wasichana Katika Sayansi" ni lipi?
example.correct_answer: Wasichana na wavulana wanaweza kufaulu katika sayansi.

misconceptions.cause: The example is a little story and stays in memory.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wazo kuu la makala "Wasichana Katika Sayansi" ni lipi?" with "Akinyi alishinda tuzo ya sayansi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: is this the point, or a case that shows the point?
misconceptions.feedback: Mfano huonyesha wazo kuu; si wazo kuu lenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes the writer's opinion for a fact, or a fact for an opinion.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni maoni ya mwandishi?
example.wrong_answer: Shule yetu ina wanafunzi mia tano.
example.correct_answer: Shule yetu ndiyo bora zaidi nchini.

misconceptions.cause: Both are stated in the article with the same confidence.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni maoni ya mwandishi?" with "Shule yetu ina wanafunzi mia tano." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: can it be checked? A fact can; an opinion is what someone thinks.
misconceptions.feedback: Maoni ni kile mtu anachofikiri; ukweli unaweza kuthibitishwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha ya Wasifu (Theme 6: Usawa wa kijinsia)
learning_experiences: kukuza hamu ya ujifunzaji kwa kutazama nakala za insha ya wasifu kwenye chapa au kwenyetarakilishi,
kutambua vipengele muhimu vya kimuundo (k.v. kichwa, mwili, hitimisho) katika uandishi wa insha ya wasifu,
kukuza umilisi wa mawasiliano na ushirikiano kwa kujadili na wenzake kuhusu mada mbalimbalizinazoweza kutungiwa insha za wasifu,

kuandika kwenye kitabu chake au kwenye tarakilishi insha ya wasifu isiyopungua maneno 200 kwa kuzingatia msamiati na ujumbe unaohusu suala lengwa. Pia azingatie ujumbe, tahajia, anwani,muundo na mtindo,
kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoiandika ili wampe maoni yao.
key_inquiry_questions: Insha ya wasifu ina sifa gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposoma nakala mbalimbali za insha ya wasifu.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi katika utungaji wa insha ya wasifu.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga insha ya wasifu.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu hoja za insha atakayoandika.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake wanapojadili.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha na kuikamilisha kwa wakati.
sub_strands.pcis:
Usawa wa kijinsia: mwanafunzi anapotunga insha ya wasifu kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika insha ya wasifu na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la usawa wa kijinsia na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya insha za wasifu ili kuibainisha
kuandika insha ya wasifu kwa kuzingatia sifa zake
kufurahia uandishi wa insha za wasifu kwa kueleza sifa za mtu, kitu, mnyama au mahali

skills.name: Tambua sehemu za insha ya wasifu
skills.mastery: Names the parts of an insha (kichwa, utangulizi, mwili, hitimisho) and puts a sentence in the right part of a wasifu, in 8 of 10 new items. Writing the insha (outcomes b and c) is composition marking.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 wrote a wasifu.

skills.name: Tambua na andika insha ya wasifu
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya wasifu from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a description of a person, place or thing with describing words that agree with their nouns and no story of events; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 1 wrote the first wasifu of the year.
The parts of a wasifu.

misconceptions.error: Names the wrong part of the insha (puts the ending in the introduction).

example.question: Sehemu ya mwisho ya insha huitwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the names of the parts but not their order.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sehemu ya mwisho ya insha huitwa ___." with "utangulizi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A part asked by its place (first, middle, last) with all the names among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ina kichwa juu, kisha utangulizi (mwanzo), mwili (katikati) na hitimisho (mwisho).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should describe the person, place or thing.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Dada Yangu Mhandisi"?
example.correct_answer: Dada yangu ni mrefu, mchangamfu, na huvaa kofia ngumu ya njano kazini.

misconceptions.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Dada Yangu Mhandisi"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it looks like, what it is for.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya wasifu hueleza jinsi kitu au mtu alivyo, si matukio ya siku moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Dada Yangu Mhandisi"?
example.correct_answer: Dada yangu ni mrefu, mchangamfu, na huvaa kofia ngumu ya njano kazini.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Dada Yangu Mhandisi"?" with "Dada yangu ni mzuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses a describing word that does not agree with its noun (bendera mzuri, miti mrefu).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?

misconceptions.cause: The child uses one form of the adjective (m-) for every noun, as he hears it for people.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?" with "Ana mikono mrefu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Find the noun first, then its ngeli, then the prefix of the adjective.
misconceptions.feedback: Kivumishi hupatana na nomino yake: bendera nzuri, miti mirefu, mtoto mzuri.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya wasifu yenye anwani "Dada Yangu Mhandisi", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Dada yangu ni mrefu, mchangamfu, na huvaa kofia ngumu ya njano kazini.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya wasifu yenye anwani "Dada Yangu Mhandisi", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Dada Yangu Mhandisi" ina sehemu zipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Insha "Dada Yangu Mhandisi" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts all the detail in the utangulizi and leaves the kiini with one line.

example.question: Utangulizi wa insha ya wasifu hufanya nini?
example.correct_answer: humtambulisha mtu au kitu kwa ufupi

misconceptions.cause: The child starts with everything he knows and runs out for the middle.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Utangulizi wa insha ya wasifu hufanya nini?" with "hueleza sifa zote za mtu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan: utangulizi one or two sentences; kiini a paragraph for each feature.
misconceptions.feedback: Utangulizi hutambulisha kwa ufupi; kiini hueleza sifa kwa kina.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Describes features in no order (face, job, eyes, home, hair), so the picture is broken.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi bora wa kiini cha wasifu wa mtu?

misconceptions.cause: The child writes features as they come to mind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi bora wa kiini cha wasifu wa mtu?" with "macho, kazi, nywele, nyumbani, uso" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Group features: appearance, character, work; one paragraph each.
misconceptions.feedback: Panga sifa kwa makundi: sura, tabia, kazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends without a hitimisho that sums up why the person or thing matters.

example.question: Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika wasifu wa mwalimu wako?
example.correct_answer: Kwa sababu ya bidii yake, mwalimu wetu ni kielelezo chema kwetu sote.

misconceptions.cause: The child stops when the features run out.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika wasifu wa mwalimu wako?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: what do you want the reader to remember about this person?
misconceptions.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga kwa kueleza umuhimu wa mtu au kitu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ngeli ya I-I (Theme 6: Usawa wa kijinsia)
learning_experiences: kutambua viambishi vya ngeli ya I-I katika sentensi kwa kuvipigia mstari au kuvikoleza rangi katika tarakilishi,
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya I-I kutokana na upatanisho wa kisarufi kwenye sentensi (k.v. chumvi, miwani na sukari, chai, kahawa, mirathi, asali, sharubati),
kuandika nomino katika ngeli ya I-I katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutunga sentensi sahihi kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya I-I kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni nomino zipihupatikana katikangeli ya I-I?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anashirikiana na wenzake.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika nomino katika ngeli ya I-I.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua nomino na ngeli zake.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vipakatalishi anavyotumia.
Uzalendo: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wenzake kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutekeleza shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Usawa wa kijinsia: mwanafunzi anapoandika mafungu ya maneno yenye nomino za ngeli ya I-I katika umoja na wingi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya nomino na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la usawa wa kijinsia na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya I - I katika sentensi
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya I - I katika sentensi ili kuzibainisha
kutumia nomino za ngeli ya I - I katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi
kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya I-I katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia ngeli ya I-I kwa upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Knows nouns that belong to I-I (afya, njaa, nguvu, subira, heshima, akili, haki, bahati: states and ideas that are not counted), gives i- as the subject prefix, and does not use zi- as for a plural, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
U-U came first: another class with no plural.

misconceptions.error: Uses zi- with an I-I noun as if it were a plural (afya zimeimarika).

example.question: Afya ___meimarika baada ya matibabu.

misconceptions.cause: The child ties i- and zi- together as the pair for one and many.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Afya ___meimarika baada ya matibabu." with "zi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Je, tunasema afyaafya? Afya ni kitu cha kuhesabu?"
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za I-I hazihesabiki, kwa hiyo hupatana na i-: afya imeimarika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses u-, li- or another prefix with an I-I noun.

example.question: Njaa ___nauma tumboni.

misconceptions.cause: The child uses the prefix of a class he knows better.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Njaa ___nauma tumboni." with "u" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A gap with several prefixes among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za I-I hupatana na i-: njaa inauma.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a noun of another class as an I-I noun.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya I-I?

misconceptions.cause: The child cannot yet tell I-I nouns by their agreement.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya I-I?" with "kitabu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with nouns from different classes.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za I-I ni hali au mawazo yasiyohesabika, kama afya na njaa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Treats an I-I noun as I-ZI and gives it zi- in a "plural" (sukari zimeisha).

example.question: Jaza: Sukari ___ (isha).

misconceptions.cause: Most n- nouns the child knows are I-ZI with a zi- plural.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Sukari ___ (isha)." with "zimeisha" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Test: can you count it? Sukari, chai, afya are not counted; they stay i-.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za I-I hazina wingi: sukari imeisha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Nahau (Theme 7: Majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia)
learning_experiences: kutambua nahau za kazi na ushirikiano (k.v. chapa kazi, kunja jamvi, changa bia, sema kwa sauti moja, fanya itifaki) katika chati, michoro, picha, vikapu maneno, mti maneno, chati, kamusi na katika vyombo vya kidijitali,
kujadili na wenzake maana za nahau za kazi na ushirikiano kwa kutoa mifano,
kuambatanisha nahau na maana yake,
kutumia nahau za kazi na ushirikiano katika sentensi akiwa peke yake au kwa kushirikiana na wenzake,
kusakura mtandaoni ili kupata nahau zaidi za kazi na ushirikiano na maana zake na kuziandika,
kujadili na wenzake nahau alizozipata ili kuelimishana.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni nahau zipi zinazohimiza watu kufanya mambo mbalimbali?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotafuta maana za nahau na kuzitumia kwa ufasaha katika mawasiliano.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu maana za nahau na matumizi yake.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi pamoja na wenzake.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii na utaifa: mwanafunzi anapotambua na kutumia nahau za kazi na ushirikiano.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anaposakura mtandaoni ili kupata nahau zaidi za kazi na ushirikiano na maana zake na kuziandika.
Uhusianona Masomo Mengine:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya nahau anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.
sub_strands.design_notes: Second read left this for a person to confirm: links: not in the design.

outcomes.text: kutambua nahau za kazi na ushirikiano katika matini mbalimbali
kujadili maana ya nahau mbalimbali za kazi na ushirikiano ili kuzitofautisha
kutumia nahau za kazi na ushirikiano katika mawasiliano
kuthamini matumizi ya nahau za kazi na ushirikiano katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na eleza maana ya nahau za kazi na ushirikiano
skills.mastery: Completes a nahau about work and teamwork (kuchapa kazi, kuvaa njuga, kuunga mkono, kutoa jasho, kujikaza kisabuni, kufunga mkanda) and says what it means, and does not read it word for word, in 8 of 10 new items. Using a nahau when speaking (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 nahau of cleanliness.

misconceptions.error: Reads the nahau word for word.

example.question: "Kukata tamaa" maana yake ni nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know that a nahau has its own meaning.
misconceptions.reveals: A meaning question with a literal option.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether anyone really cuts tamaa.
misconceptions.feedback: Nahau ina maana tofauti na maneno yake. "Kukata tamaa" ni kuacha kuwa na matumaini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the meaning of another nahau.

example.question: "Kula chumvi" maana yake ni nini?
example.correct_answer: kuwa na umri mkubwa na uzoefu

misconceptions.cause: The child knows several nahau but swaps meanings.
misconceptions.reveals: The meaning of another nahau as an option.
misconceptions.help: Ask what experience chumvi stands for.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila nahau ina maana yake. "Kula chumvi" ni kuwa na uzoefu wa miaka mingi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Completes the nahau with a different word (kukata moyo for kukata tamaa).

example.question: Usikate ___ ukishindwa mara moja.

misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the shape but changes a word.
misconceptions.reveals: A nahau gap where a near word is an option.
misconceptions.help: Recite the whole nahau.
misconceptions.feedback: Nahau hazibadiliki: kukata tamaa, kupiga moyo konde. Neno moja likibadilika, maana hupotea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses a nahau of work in a sentence where its meaning does not fit (Alijifunga kibwebwe kulala).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi imetumia "kujifunga kibwebwe" ipasavyo?
example.correct_answer: Alijifunga kibwebwe akamaliza kazi ya shamba.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the words, not the situation.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi imetumia "kujifunga kibwebwe" ipasavyo?" with "Alijifunga kibwebwe akalala." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the meaning (to get ready to work hard) and test the sentence against it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kujifunga kibwebwe ni kujiandaa kufanya kazi kwa bidii.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 7: Majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia)
learning_experiences: kutambua aina mbalimbali za matini (k.v. vitabu, magazeti, na majarida) kwenye tarakilishi au kadi za katalogi,
kuchagua matini atakayoisoma,
kusoma matini kimyakimya ili kupata ujumbe uliopo na kufaidi matumizi ya lugha,
kusimulia ujumbe kutokana na matini alizosoma kwa wenzake,
kujadiliana na wenzake matini alizosoma ili kuchochea hamu ya usomaji wa mapana miongoni mwao.
key_inquiry_questions: Unapendakusoma matini ya aina gani?
Ni vipi unavyoweza kupata matini ya kusoma?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposoma na kusimulia ujumbe aliosoma kutokana na matini za aina mbalimbali.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anaposoma matini mbalimbali kuhusu majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia ili kupata ujumbe.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuzingatia maoni katika mijadala.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapoazima, kutunza na kurudisha vitabu maktabani
sub_strands.pcis:
Majanga na jinsi ya kuzuia: mwanafunzi anapotambue aina mbalimbali za matini (k.v. vitabu, magazeti, na majarida) kwenye tarakilishi au kadi za katalogi kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa mapana na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua matini anazotaka kusoma kwenye maktaba
kuchagua matini anazotaka kusoma kwenye maktaba
kusoma matini ili kufaidika na ujumbe na lugha inayotumiwa
kufurahia usomaji wa matini za aina mbalimbali ili kujenga utamaduni wa kusoma

skills.name: Chagua matini ya kusoma na ueleze ujumbe wake
skills.mastery: Chooses a text that suits his reading level and interest from its title, blurb and first page (not from the cover alone), tells the kind of text (hadithi, shairi, makala, gazeti), says its message in one sentence, and works out a new word from the sentence around it, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 5 chose and read texts by title, blurb and level.
Finding the message of a passage.

misconceptions.error: Chooses a book by its cover picture or its thickness only.

example.question: Unataka kusoma kuhusu majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia. Utachaguaje kitabu?
example.correct_answer: kwa kusoma anwani, maelezo ya nyuma na ukurasa wa kwanza

misconceptions.cause: Nobody has shown the child the title, the blurb and the first page as clues.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unataka kusoma kuhusu majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia. Utachaguaje kitabu?" with "kwa picha nzuri ya jalada" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Hold up two books; read the title and the back of each aloud; the child chooses and says which clue decided it.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani, maelezo ya nyuma ya kitabu na ukurasa wa kwanza hukuambia kitabu kinahusu nini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Chooses a text far above his reading level and gives up after a page.

example.question: Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Mafuriko ya Budalang'i" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: chagua matini nyingine iliyo ya kiwango chako

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks a harder book is a better book, or chooses the book a friend chose.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Mafuriko ya Budalang'i" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?" with "endelea tu hata kama huelewi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The five-finger check: on one page, a finger for each unknown word; five fingers means the book is too hard for now.
misconceptions.feedback: Matini ifaayo ni ile unayoweza kuisoma na kuielewa ukiwa peke yako.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the title as the message of the text.

example.question: Ujumbe wa matini "Mafuriko ya Budalang'i" ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tukijiandaa mapema na kufuata maagizo, tunapunguza madhara ya majanga.

misconceptions.cause: The title is the only sentence about the whole text that the child is sure of.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa matini "Mafuriko ya Budalang'i" ni upi?" with "Mafuriko ya Budalang'i" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the writer wants the reader to learn or do; the title only names the topic.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni funzo au wazo kuu ambalo mwandishi anataka ulipate.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one detail of the text as its message.

example.question: Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia?
example.wrong_answer: Maji yalifika kwenye madirisha ya nyumba.
example.correct_answer: Tukijiandaa mapema na kufuata maagizo, tunapunguza madhara ya majanga.

misconceptions.cause: The detail was striking and is remembered; the child has not asked what the whole text is about.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia?" with "Maji yalifika kwenye madirisha ya nyumba." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two boxes: "ujumbe" (one) and "maelezo" (many); the child sorts sentences from the text.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe unahusu matini yote; jambo moja dogo ni maelezo tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not tell one kind of text from another (takes a newspaper report for a story, or a poem for a story).

example.question: Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child has met most texts as "kitabu" and has not been shown the signs of each kind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?" with "hadithi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Lay out a story, a poem, a newspaper page and a dictionary; the child names one sign of each.
misconceptions.feedback: Shairi lina beti na mishororo; hadithi ina aya; gazeti lina habari na tarehe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Guesses a new word from how it looks, not from the sentence it is in (tahadhari).

example.question: Katika matini: "Wanakijiji walipewa tahadhari kabla ya mvua kubwa kunyesha." Neno "tahadhari" lina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the word to a word it looks like instead of reading the sentence around it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika matini: "Wanakijiji walipewa tahadhari kabla ya mvua kubwa kunyesha." Neno "tahadhari" lina maana gani?" with "tarehe ya mkutano" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Cover the word; the child reads the sentence and says what word would fit; then compares.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma sentensi nzima: "tahadhari" hapa ni onyo la mapema kuhusu hatari.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Maelezo (Theme 7: Majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia)
learning_experiences: kutambua vifungu vya insha za maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi (k.v. maelezo kuhusu kuzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo, mafuriko, mitetemeko ya ardhi, mkurupuko wa magonjwa kama vile kipindupindu),
kujadili mada na vidokezo vya insha atakayoiandika,

kuandika insha ya maelezo isiyopungua maneno 200 akizingatia kategoria za maneno kama vile aina mbalimbali za viwakilishi ifaavyo ili kuuwasilisha ujumbe lengwa, anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu unaojumuisha methali na nahau alizojifunza awali,
kutunga insha ya maelezo mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini,
kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini unapoandika insha ya maelezo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kiteknolojia vinapotumiwa kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya maelezo.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofanikiwa kutunga insha ya maelezo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapotekeleza shughuli kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia: mwanafunzi anapotunga insha ya maelezo kuhusu suala lengwa (k.v. maelezo kuhusu kuzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo, mafuriko, mitetemeko ya ardhi, mkurupuko wa magonjwa kama vile kipindupindu).
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotunga insha ya maelezo mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika insha na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kujadili maudhui ya insha ya maelezo ili kukuza ubunifu
kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kuzingatia mada, mtiririko, sarufi, muundo na mtindo ufaao
kuchangamkia utungaji wa insha za maelezo ili kukuza hali ya kujiamini

skills.name: Tambua na andika insha ya maelezo
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes an explanation or description on the topic, in order, with detail that makes a picture and no point off the topic; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 5 wrote the first maelezo of the year.
The features of a maelezo.

misconceptions.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should explain or describe.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, zima jiko la mkaa kabla ya kulala.

misconceptions.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it is, how it works or is done.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, zima jiko la mkaa kabla ya kulala.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani"?" with "Moto ni hatari." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the steps of how to do something in a mixed-up order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani"?
example.wrong_answer: jua njia ya kutoka, usiache taa ikiwaka, weka viberiti mbali na watoto, zima jiko
example.correct_answer: zima jiko, weka viberiti mbali na watoto, usiache taa ikiwaka, jua njia ya kutoka

misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the steps as a set, not as a sequence.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani"?" with "jua njia ya kutoka, usiache taa ikiwaka, weka viberiti mbali na watoto, zima jiko" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out the steps; number them; write them with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
misconceptions.feedback: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, zima jiko la mkaa kabla ya kulala.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani" ina sehemu zipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Insha "Jinsi ya Kujikinga na Moto Nyumbani" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ngeli ya PA-KU-MU (Theme 7: Majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia)
learning_experiences: kutambua viambishi vya ngeli ya PA-KU-MU katika matini,
kuandika nomino katika ngeli ya PA-KU-MU katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake,,
kubadilisha sentensi kuzingatia viambishi vya ngeli ya PA-KU-MU katika umoja na wingi,
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia viambishi vya ngeli ya PA-KU-MU akiwa peke yake au kwa kushirikiana na wenzake,
kujaza mapengo kwa kutumia viambishi vya ngeli ya PA-KU- MU kwa maandishi ya mkono au kwa tarakilishi.
key_inquiry_questions: Tunawezaje kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya PA-KU-MU?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anashirikiana na wenzake.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua nomino na ngeli ya PA-KU-MU.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi kutunza vipakatalishi anavyotumia.
Uzalendo: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wenzake kwa kushirikiana.
sub_strands.pcis:
Majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia: mwanafunzi anapoandika nomino katika ngeli ya PA-KU-MU katika umoja na wingi kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya nomino na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la majanga na jinsi ya kuyazuia na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.
sub_strands.design_notes: Second read left this for a person to confirm: no lessons figure.

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi vya ngeli ya PA-KU-MU katika matini
kutumia ipasavyo upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya PA- KU-MU katika matini
kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya PA-KU-MU katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia ngeli ya PA-KU-MU kwa upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Matches the word of place and the verb in PA-KU-MU: pa- for a particular place (pale pana), ku- for a far or general place (kule kuna), mu- or m- for inside (mle mna), in 8 of 10 new sentences.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
KU- of verbal nouns is learnt before KU- of place.

misconceptions.error: Uses the wrong one of pa-, ku-, mu- for the place (kule pana).

example.question: Kule shambani ___ mazao mengi.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not read the word of place (pale, kule, humu).
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kule shambani ___ mazao mengi." with "pana" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence with pale, kule or humu and all three forms among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Pale huchukua pa-, kule huchukua ku-, humu na mle huchukua mu- (m-).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the prefix of the noun (una, ina) where the place needs pa-, ku- or mu-.

example.question: Kule shambani ___ mazao mengi.

misconceptions.cause: The child follows the noun and not the place.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kule shambani ___ mazao mengi." with "ina" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with u- and i- forms.
misconceptions.feedback: Katika ngeli ya mahali, kitenzi hupatana na mahali (pa-, ku-, mu-), si na nomino.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the noun's own prefix with a place noun in -ni (nyumbani imesafishwa for nyumbani kumesafishwa).

example.question: Jaza: Shuleni ___ (safishwa).

misconceptions.cause: The child sees the noun shule (I-ZI) and keeps its prefix.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Shuleni ___ (safishwa)." with "imesafishwa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A place in -ni moves to PA-KU-MU: shuleni pa- (exact place), ku- (general), mu- (inside).
misconceptions.feedback: Mahali (-ni) huchukua pa-, ku- au mu-: shuleni kumesafishwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses ku- or pa- for inside a thing where mu- is needed (ndani ya nyumba kuna giza for mna giza).

example.question: Jaza: Ndani ya chumba ___ giza.

misconceptions.cause: Kuna is the common "there is" and the child uses it everywhere.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Ndani ya chumba ___ giza." with "pana" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act: inside a box (mu-), at a spot (pa-), around/far (ku-).
misconceptions.feedback: Ndani ya kitu tunatumia mu-: chumbani mna giza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Visawe (Theme 8: Wanyama wa majini)
learning_experiences: kutambua maneno zaidi ya matatu yenye maana sawa (k.v. mwizi- luja, mkupuzi, pwagu, pwaguzi, mkwepuzi; hongo, rushwa, chai, kadhongo, mvugulio; pesa - njenje, ngwenje, fedha, hela; lengo - dhamira, nia, azma, kusudi; maskini, mlalahoi, fukara, mkata, fakiri) kwa kutumia kapu la maneno, kadi za maneno, mti wa maneno, tarakilishi,
kueleza maana ya maneno zaidi yamatatu yenye maana sawa kwa kujadiliana na wenzake,
kuambatanisha maneno zaidi ya matatu yaliyo na maana sawa katika kapu maneno, mti maneno, ubao, chati, vyombo vya kidijitali na kadi za maneno,
kuhusisha visawe na vifaa halisi,picha, michoro kwenye chati, kitabu au katika vyombo vya kidijitali,
kujadili visawe mbalimbali akiwa na wenzake,
kutumia kisawe kimoja kuchukua nafasi ya kingine katika sentensi.
key_inquiry_questions: Unajua maneno gani ya Kiswahili yaliyo na maana sawa?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wenzake
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu visawe mwafaka.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutambua visawe.
sub_strands.values: Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kutunga sentensi zinazojumuisha maadili mbalimbali k.v. umoja, uzalendo, uwajibikaji na upendo.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya utunzaji wa wanyama: mwanafunzi anapohusisha visawe na vifaa halisi, picha, michoro kwenye chati akirejelea suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya visawe anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la wanyama wa majini na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua maneno zaidi ya matatu yenye maana sawa katika kundi la maneno
kutumia visawe ifaavyo katika mawasiliano
kuthamini matumizi ya maneno zaidi ya matatu yenye maana sawa katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua visawe na makundi ya maneno yenye maana sawa
skills.mastery: Picks the word with almost the same meaning (furaha-bashasha, haraka-upesi) and the group of four words that all share one meaning, and does not pick the opposite, a related word or a group with one opposite in it, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 found three synonyms.

misconceptions.error: Picks the opposite where the same meaning is asked.

example.question: Kisawe cha "furaha" ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child links furaha and huzuni because they go together.
misconceptions.reveals: A synonym question with the opposite as an option.
misconceptions.help: Ask whether the two words mean the same.
misconceptions.feedback: Visawe ni maneno yenye maana sawa. Furaha na huzuni ni vinyume, si visawe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word about the same topic but with a different meaning.

example.question: Kisawe cha "huzuni" ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child picks what goes with the word, not what means the same.
misconceptions.reveals: A related word as an option.
misconceptions.help: Could you swap the two words in a sentence and keep the same meaning?
misconceptions.feedback: Neno linalohusiana na jingine si lazima liwe na maana sawa nalo. Kisawe cha huzuni ni simanzi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word that looks or sounds like the word.

example.question: Kisawe cha "haraka" ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child goes by the first letters.
misconceptions.reveals: A look-alike word as an option.
misconceptions.help: Say what each word means.
misconceptions.feedback: Maneno yanaweza kuanza kwa herufi zilezile na yasiwe na maana sawa. Kisawe cha haraka ni upesi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a group that has one opposite or unrelated word among the synonyms.

example.question: Ni kundi lipi lina maneno yote yenye maana sawa na "furaha"?

misconceptions.cause: The child checks the first words of the group and not every word.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kundi lipi lina maneno yote yenye maana sawa na "furaha"?" with "bashasha, huzuni, raha, tabasamu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A group with three synonyms and one opposite.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila neno la kundi lazima liwe na maana sawa. Huzuni ni kinyume cha furaha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 8: Wanyama wa majini)
learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya mchezo wa kuigiza akishirikiana na wenzake,
kujadili na wenzake sifa za mchezo wa kuigiza (k.v. huwa na wahusika, kuna mazungumzo, maelekezo),
kusoma mchezo wa kuigiza akizingatia wahusika, maelekezo na ujumbe,
kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa uliotumiwa katika mchezo wa kuigiza (k.v. kiboko, samaki, mamba, chura, kasa),
kushiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu msamiati uliotumiwa katika mchezo wa kuigiza,
kujibu maswali kutokana na mchezo aliousoma,
kutoa muhtasari wa ujumbe ulio katika mchezo wa kuigiza,
kutazama mchezo mfupi wa kuigiza shuleni au kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali,
kushiriki katika mjadala kuhusu ujumbe unaojitokeza kwenye mchezo wa kuigiza.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, mchezo wa kuigiza una sifa gani?
Umewahi kushiriki katika mchezo gani wa kuigiza?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika mchakato wa ujifunzaji.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapofikiri kuhusu ujumbe uliomo kwenye mchezo wa kuigiza.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapong’amua ujumbe uliomo kwenye mchezo wa kuigiza.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu uigizaji wa wenzake.
Umoja: wanaposhirikiana kuigiza mchezo kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya utunzaji wa wanyama: mwanafunzi anapotambua msamiati wa suala lengwa uliotumiwa katika mchezo wa kuigiza.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Mshikamano wa kijamii na utaifa: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kuigiza suala lengwa na masuala mengine yanayohusiana na jamii.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa ufahamu anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la wanyama wa majini na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kujadili sifa za mchezo wa kuigiza ili kuzibainisha
kusoma mchezo mfupi wa kuigiza kwa ufasaha kwa kuzingatia ujumbe na msamiati wa suala lengwa
kuonyesha ufahamu wa mchezo wa kuigiza kwa kujibu maswali na kutoa muhtasari
kuonea fahari nafasi ya mchezo wa kuigiza katika jamii

skills.name: Tambua na elewa mchezo wa kuigiza
skills.mastery: Tells a play from a story (names of speakers, words spoken, directions in brackets), says what a word in the play means, and answers questions about it, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 read a play in parts.

misconceptions.error: Reads the words in brackets (what to do on stage) as words a character says.

example.question: Maelekezo ya jukwaani katika igizo ni yapi?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads a play as a story.
misconceptions.reveals: A play with brackets and spoken lines.
misconceptions.help: Brackets tell the actor what to do, not what to say.
misconceptions.feedback: Maneno yaliyo kwenye mabano ni maelekezo ya kitendo, si maneno ya mhusika. Hayasomwi kama mazungumzo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not tell a play from a story.

example.question: Ni kipi kati ya hivi ni igizo?

misconceptions.cause: The child sees a short text and does not look at the form.
misconceptions.reveals: A play and a story on the same event.
misconceptions.help: Look for the speaker names with a colon.
misconceptions.feedback: Igizo huonyesha jina la mhusika, nukta mbili, kisha maneno anayosema. Hadithi huelezwa na msimulizi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a character who did not say the line.

example.question: Nani alisema "Nitakuletea maji"?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not follow the names before the colons.
misconceptions.reveals: A who-said-it question.
misconceptions.help: Find the line and read the name before it.
misconceptions.feedback: Jina lililo mbele ya nukta mbili ndilo la mtu anayesema maneno yaliyofuata.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a wrong detail of the play (the place, the thing bought).

example.question: Akinyi alienda wapi?

misconceptions.cause: The child remembers a place named near the question.
misconceptions.reveals: A where-or-what question with another detail of the play.
misconceptions.help: Find the line where it is said.
misconceptions.feedback: Rudi kwenye igizo na utafute mstari unaotaja jibu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the wrong meaning of a word in the play.

example.question: Neno "kuandamana" lina maana gani katika igizo?

misconceptions.cause: The child guesses from the look of the word.
misconceptions.reveals: A meaning question for a word in the play.
misconceptions.help: Read the line where the word is used and think who goes with whom.
misconceptions.feedback: Maana ya neno hutokana na mstari lilimotumika katika igizo. Soma mstari huo tena.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Masimulizi (Theme 8: Wanyama wa majini)
learning_experiences: kujadili mtiririko wa hoja katika insha ya masimulizi kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,
kujadili muundo wa insha ya masimulizi,

kuonyesha ubunifu kwa kuandika insha isiyopungua maneno 200 inayosimulia tukio linalohusiana na wanyama wa porini akizingatia nomino na vivumishi mbalimbali, mnyambuliko wa vitenzi, anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka, lugha ya kiubunifu na urefu unaotarajiwa,
kukuza ujuzi wa kidijitali kwa kuandika insha ya masimuizi katika vifaa vya kidijitali na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini,
kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini na kumwelekeza
key_inquiry_questions: Ni nini unachoweza kufanya ili uwe mwandishi bora wa insha?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala akiwa na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kiteknolojia vinapotumiwa kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya masimuizi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimuizi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maswali dadisi yaliyopendekezwa na anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi kuandika Insha za wasifu zinazolenga watu ambao wanajulikana kwa uaminifu, uwajibikaji, wenye mapenzi na wazalendo.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya utunzaji wa wanyama: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuandika insha ya masimulizi katika vifaa vya kidijitali na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika insha ya masimulizi anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la wanyama wa majini na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kujadili mtiririko wa hoja katika insha ya masimulizi
kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo
kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri katika uandishi wa insha ya masimulizi

skills.name: Tambua na andika insha ya masimulizi
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya masimulizi from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a story of events in the past tense, in order, with a title, an opening, a middle and a closing that gives the lesson; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 2 planned and wrote a masimulizi.
The features of a masimulizi.

misconceptions.error: Writes facts or an explanation where a story of events is asked.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?
example.wrong_answer: Kasa ni mnyama anayeishi majini kwa miaka mingi.
example.correct_answer: Tulimwona kasa amenaswa kwenye nyavu za wavuvi.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows a lot about the topic and writes what he knows instead of telling what happened.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?" with "Kasa ni mnyama anayeishi majini kwa miaka mingi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: who, where, what happened first, then, in the end? A story answers these; an explanation does not.
misconceptions.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio yaliyotokea: nani, wapi, nini kilitokea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Tells a past story in the present tense (-na-), or mixes -na- and -li- in one story.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?
example.wrong_answer: Tunamwona kasa amenaswa kwenye nyavu za wavuvi.
example.correct_answer: Tulimwona kasa amenaswa kwenye nyavu za wavuvi.

misconceptions.cause: The child writes as he speaks while remembering, and English stories in class are told in the present too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?" with "Tunamwona kasa amenaswa kwenye nyavu za wavuvi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Circle every verb; check its tense marker against the time words (jana, siku moja).
misconceptions.feedback: Jambo lililotokea husimuliwa kwa wakati uliopita: -li-.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?
example.wrong_answer: kasa aliogelea baharini, tulikata nyavu, tuliwaita wavuvi, tulimwona kasa
example.correct_answer: tulimwona kasa, tuliwaita wavuvi, tulikata nyavu, kasa aliogelea baharini

misconceptions.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?" with "kasa aliogelea baharini, tulikata nyavu, tuliwaita wavuvi, tulimwona kasa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
