misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza kuwa mwangalifu kila wakati.

misconceptions.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Kasa Aliyeokolewa"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
misconceptions.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes what a character said without the alama za usemi and the comma (Mama alisema njoo hapa).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa sawa?

misconceptions.cause: Speech is written as the child hears it, with no sign of where the words begin and end.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi imeandikwa sawa?" with "Mama alisema njoo hapa haraka." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the exact words said; put them inside the marks, with a comma before and a capital inside.
misconceptions.feedback: Maneno halisi ya msemaji huwekwa ndani ya alama za usemi: "Njoo hapa."
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Mnyambuliko wa (Theme 8: Wanyama wa majini)
learning_experiences: kutambua vitenzi katika hali za kutendeana, kutendesha na kutendua katika chati, jedwali, kapu maneno, mti maneno, ubao na vyombo vya kidijitali,
kunyambua vitenzi katika hali lengwa akiwa peke yake, akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutumia vitenzi katika hali lengwa kwenye sentensi,
kujaza mapengo katika jedwali la mnyambuliko wa vitenzi kwenye daftari au kwa kutumia tarakilishi,
kuandika sentensi upya kwa kutumia vitenzi katika hali mbalimbali.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, vitenzi vinaweza kubadilika vipi mwishoni ili kuleta maana mbalimbali?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anaponyambua vitenzi katika hali mbalimbali.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotoa majibu na kushiriki katika shughuli mbalimbali.
sub_strands.values: mbalimbali k.v. upendo, umoja, heshima, uzalendo n.k. kutokana na sentensi zilizotungwa.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya utunzaji wa wanyama: mwanafunzi anaponyambua vitenzi kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Mahusiano ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotumia vitenzi katika hali mbalimbali ipasavyo kuonyesha na kuendeleza mahusiano katika jamii.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya mnyambuliko wa vitenzi anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la wanyama wa majini na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua vitenzi katika hali ya kutendeana, kutendesha, kutendua katika matini
kutumia vitenzi katika hali za kutendeana, kutendesha, kutendua ipasavyo katika sentensi
kuchangamkia matumizi ya vitenzi katika hali ya kutendeana, kutendesha, kutendua katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na tumia kutendeana, kutendesha na kutendua
skills.mastery: Tells the three verb forms apart (kutendeana: each does it for the other, as in kuandikiana; kutendesha: makes someone do it, as in kuimbisha; kutendua: undoes it, as in kufungua) and picks the one a sentence needs, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 extended verbs to -ewa, -eka, -ana.

misconceptions.error: Keeps the simple verb where a longer form is needed (hupika for hupikiana).

example.question: Majirani hao ___ chakula kila Jumapili. (kila mmoja humpikia mwenzake)

misconceptions.cause: The child reads the verb and not what the sentence says about who does it for whom.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Majirani hao ___ chakula kila Jumapili. (kila mmoja humpikia mwenzake)" with "hupika" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Nani anampikia nani?" If each cooks for the other, the verb needs -ana.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitenzi cha kawaida hakionyeshi kwamba kila mmoja anamtendea mwenzake. Kutendeana: hupikiana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the verb for one doing it for another (hupikia) where each does it for the other (hupikiana).

example.question: Otieno na Achieng ___ barua kila mwezi.

misconceptions.cause: The child leaves out -ana.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Otieno na Achieng ___ barua kila mwezi." with "huandikia" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence in which two people do the same for each other.
misconceptions.feedback: Wawili wakitendeana, kitenzi huishia -ana: huandikiana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a verb form that does not fit the meaning (huandikisha for huandikiana).

example.question: Mwalimu ___ watoto kuimba wimbo mpya. (huwafanya waimbe)

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes the endings -ana, -isha and -ua.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu ___ watoto kuimba wimbo mpya. (huwafanya waimbe)" with "huimbiana" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with each ending and a gloss in brackets.
misconceptions.feedback: -ana ni kila mmoja kwa mwenzake, -isha ni kumfanya mtu atende, na -ua ni kufanya kinyume.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Makes the reversive (kutendua) of any verb with -ua, even where it does not exist (kulaua, kusomua).

example.question: Kauli ya kutendua ya "funga" ni?

misconceptions.cause: Funga/fungua and vaa/vua make -ua look like a rule for all verbs.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kauli ya kutendua ya "funga" ni?" with "fungana" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Keep a list of real reversives (funga/fungua, choma/chomoa, ziba/zibua); test new ones in the dictionary.
misconceptions.feedback: Kutendua hubadilisha tendo kuwa kinyume chake: funga -> fungua; si kila kitenzi kina kutendua.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Mazungumzo ya Kimuktadha (Theme 9: Afya ya akili)
learning_experiences: kutambua miktadha mbalimbali kunakotumiwa lugha rasmi na isiyo rasmi (k.v. ofisini, hospitalini, nyumbani, sokoni),
kusikiliza mazungumzo rasmi na yasiyo rasmi kwa kutazama maigizo kwenye vyombo vya kidijitali (k.v. video, rununu, runinga, tarakilishi),
kushiriki katika maigizo ya mazungumzo ya miktadha rasmi na yasiyo rasmi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kushiriki katika mazungumzo rasmi na yasiyo rasmi kuhusu suala lengwa (k.v, mambo yanayosababisha msongo wa mawazo unao sababishwa na ajali za barabarani n.k),
kutambua nidhamu ya lugha inayozingatiwa katika mazingira rasmi (k.m lugha ya heshima na adabu anapowasiliana).
key_inquiry_questions: Ni wapi katika shughuli zetu za kila siku tunaitumia lugha rasmi na isiyo rasmi?
Ni nini kinachofanya mazungumzo yawe rasmi au yasiyo rasmi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake darasani.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapobuni na kushiriki katika mazungumzo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza na kutazama mazungumzo.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu wenzake wakati wa kuigiza na kushiriki katika mazungumzo.
sub_strands.pcis:
Afya ya akili: mwanafunzi anapotambua miktadha tofauti ya matumizi ya lugha rasmi na isiyo rasmi kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Mahusiano ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotumia lugha rasmi na isiyo rasmi katika miktadha faafu ili kuimarisha mahusiano ya kijamii.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusikiliza anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la afya ya akili na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua miktadha rasmi na isiyo rasmi katika mawasiliano ili kuitofautisha
kutumia lugha katika miktadha rasmi na isiyo rasmi ili kufanikisha mawasiliano
kuchangamkia matumizi ya lugha katika miktadha rasmi na isiyo rasmi kuimarisha maadili yafaayo

skills.name: Tofautisha lugha rasmi na isiyo rasmi
skills.mastery: Tells formal language (for a meeting, a leader, a letter) from informal language (for friends and home) and picks the sentence that fits the person and the place, in 8 of 10 new items. Speaking in each context (outcome b, in full) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 used official language in official settings.

misconceptions.error: Calls formal language informal, or informal language formal.

example.question: "Niaje, msee?" ni lugha ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not look at who is speaking to whom.
misconceptions.reveals: The question ""Niaje, msee?" ni lugha ___." with "rasmi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A greeting between friends and a greeting to a leader.
misconceptions.feedback: Lugha rasmi ni ya heshima na ya viongozi. Lugha isiyo rasmi ni ya marafiki na nyumbani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses slang or casual words with a teacher, a leader or at a meeting.

example.question: Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na mwalimu mkuu.
example.correct_answer: Mwalimu mkuu, naomba ruhusa ya kuondoka mapema.

misconceptions.cause: The child uses the way he talks to friends everywhere.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na mwalimu mkuu." with "Nipe ruhusa tu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: A request to a leader with a casual version among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa mwalimu, kiongozi au mkutano rasmi tunatumia maneno ya heshima.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses very formal words with a friend or a sister at home.

example.question: Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na rafiki uwanjani.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks formal words are always better.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi inayofaa unapozungumza na rafiki uwanjani." with "Naomba kibali cha kuanza mchezo." among the options.
misconceptions.help: A friendly invitation next to a formal one.
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa rafiki au ndugu nyumbani, lugha ya kawaida inafaa. Lugha rasmi kupita kiasi inasikika ya ajabu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Speaks on the phone to an official as to a friend (Sema!, Uko wapi?) with no greeting or name.

example.question: Unampigia simu mwalimu mkuu. Unaanza vipi?
example.correct_answer: Hujambo mwalimu mkuu? Ni mimi Amina wa darasa la sita.

misconceptions.cause: Phone talk with friends is the model the child knows.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unampigia simu mwalimu mkuu. Unaanza vipi?" with "Sema! Uko wapi?" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Role-play a phone call: greet, say who you are, say why you call, thank, take leave.
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa simu rasmi: salimu, jitambulishe, eleza sababu, shukuru.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 9: Afya ya akili)
learning_experiences: kutambua matini zinazomvutia maktabani na mtandaoni,
kusoma matini alizochagua ili kufaidi ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa,
kutolea wenzake muhtasari wa kile alichosoma kwenye matini ili kupashana ujumbe na kuchocheana kusoma zaidi kwa ajili ya kujifurahisha,
kujadiliana na wenzake matini ambazo wamesoma kwa kuzingatia ukuzaji wa msamiati.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni habari zipi unazopenda kusoma kwenye matini?
Unazingatia nini unapochagua matini za kusoma?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposimulia na kujadiliana na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi na mtandao kupata matini za kusoma.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojichagulia matini na kuzisoma.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza matini anazosoma.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu alichosoma.
sub_strands.pcis:
Afya ya akili: mwanafunzi anapotambua na kusoma matini zinazomvutia maktabani na mtandaoni kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotambua matini zinazomvutia mtandaoni na kuzisoma.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa mapana anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la afya ya akili na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies. Shughuli za Ujifunzaji Zilizopendekezwa Swali Dadisi

outcomes.text: kutambua aina mbalimbali za matini ili kuchagua inayomvutia
kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidika na ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa
kufurahia usomaji wa aina mbalimbali za matini ili kupanua mawazo yake

skills.name: Chagua matini ya kusoma na ueleze ujumbe wake
skills.mastery: Chooses a text that suits his reading level and interest from its title, blurb and first page (not from the cover alone), tells the kind of text (hadithi, shairi, makala, gazeti), says its message in one sentence, and works out a new word from the sentence around it, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 7 chose and read a text.
A new word can be checked in the dictionary.

misconceptions.error: Chooses a book by its cover picture or its thickness only.

example.question: Unataka kusoma kuhusu afya ya akili. Utachaguaje kitabu?
example.correct_answer: kwa kusoma anwani, maelezo ya nyuma na ukurasa wa kwanza

misconceptions.cause: Nobody has shown the child the title, the blurb and the first page as clues.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unataka kusoma kuhusu afya ya akili. Utachaguaje kitabu?" with "kwa picha nzuri ya jalada" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Hold up two books; read the title and the back of each aloud; the child chooses and says which clue decided it.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani, maelezo ya nyuma ya kitabu na ukurasa wa kwanza hukuambia kitabu kinahusu nini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Chooses a text far above his reading level and gives up after a page.

example.question: Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Zawadi Azungumza na Mshauri" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: chagua matini nyingine iliyo ya kiwango chako

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks a harder book is a better book, or chooses the book a friend chose.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Zawadi Azungumza na Mshauri" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?" with "endelea tu hata kama huelewi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The five-finger check: on one page, a finger for each unknown word; five fingers means the book is too hard for now.
misconceptions.feedback: Matini ifaayo ni ile unayoweza kuisoma na kuielewa ukiwa peke yako.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the title as the message of the text.

example.question: Ujumbe wa matini "Zawadi Azungumza na Mshauri" ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tukizungumza na mtu tunayemwamini, tunapunguza mawazo mazito.

misconceptions.cause: The title is the only sentence about the whole text that the child is sure of.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa matini "Zawadi Azungumza na Mshauri" ni upi?" with "Zawadi Azungumza na Mshauri" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the writer wants the reader to learn or do; the title only names the topic.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni funzo au wazo kuu ambalo mwandishi anataka ulipate.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one detail of the text as its message.

example.question: Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu afya ya akili?
example.wrong_answer: Zawadi alikaa chini ya mti peke yake.
example.correct_answer: Tukizungumza na mtu tunayemwamini, tunapunguza mawazo mazito.

misconceptions.cause: The detail was striking and is remembered; the child has not asked what the whole text is about.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu afya ya akili?" with "Zawadi alikaa chini ya mti peke yake." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two boxes: "ujumbe" (one) and "maelezo" (many); the child sorts sentences from the text.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe unahusu matini yote; jambo moja dogo ni maelezo tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not tell one kind of text from another (takes a newspaper report for a story, or a poem for a story).

example.question: Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child has met most texts as "kitabu" and has not been shown the signs of each kind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?" with "hadithi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Lay out a story, a poem, a newspaper page and a dictionary; the child names one sign of each.
misconceptions.feedback: Shairi lina beti na mishororo; hadithi ina aya; gazeti lina habari na tarehe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Guesses a new word from how it looks, not from the sentence it is in (msongo).

example.question: Katika matini: "Msongo wa mawazo ulimfanya Zawadi akose usingizi." Neno "msongo" lina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the word to a word it looks like instead of reading the sentence around it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika matini: "Msongo wa mawazo ulimfanya Zawadi akose usingizi." Neno "msongo" lina maana gani?" with "msitu mnene" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Cover the word; the child reads the sentence and says what word would fit; then compares.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma sentensi nzima: "msongo" hapa ni mawazo mengi yanayomlemea mtu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Maelezo (Theme 9: Afya ya akili)
learning_experiences: kueleza maudhui kutokana na mada ya insha ya maelezo,
kujadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya maelezo,

kuandika insha ya maelezo akitumia vivumishi na vielezi vifaavyo kutoa picha dhahiri kuhusu anachokielezea. Pia akizingatie anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na lugha ya kiubunifu inayojumuisha methali na nahau alizojifunza awali,

kuandika insha ya maelezo akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuhusu suala lengwa (k.v athari za msongo wa mawazo kwa sababu ya ajali za barabarani na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini),
kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni mambo gani unayoweza kuwasilisha unapoandika insha ya maelezo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kiteknolojia wakati wa kuandika insha ya maelezo mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya maelezo.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maswali dadisi yaliyopendekezwa na anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi pamoja.
sub_strands.pcis:
Afya ya akili: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotumia ujuzi wa kidijitali kuandika insha ya maelezo.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la afya ya akili na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maudhui ya insha ya maelezo kwa kuzingatia mada
kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo ili kufanikisha, mawasiliano
kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wenye mapambo ya lugha

skills.name: Tambua na andika insha ya maelezo
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes an explanation or description on the topic, in order, with detail that makes a picture and no point off the topic; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 7 wrote a maelezo with a clear flow.
The features of a maelezo.

misconceptions.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should explain or describe.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, zungumza na mtu unayemwamini kuhusu jambo linalokusumbua.

misconceptions.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it is, how it works or is done.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, zungumza na mtu unayemwamini kuhusu jambo linalokusumbua.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi"?" with "Mawazo ni mabaya." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the steps of how to do something in a mixed-up order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi"?
example.wrong_answer: omba msaada wa mshauri, lala vya kutosha, cheza au fanya mazoezi, zungumza na mtu
example.correct_answer: zungumza na mtu, cheza au fanya mazoezi, lala vya kutosha, omba msaada wa mshauri

misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the steps as a set, not as a sequence.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi"?" with "omba msaada wa mshauri, lala vya kutosha, cheza au fanya mazoezi, zungumza na mtu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out the steps; number them; write them with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
misconceptions.feedback: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, zungumza na mtu unayemwamini kuhusu jambo linalokusumbua.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the whole insha as one paragraph with no utangulizi, kiini and hitimisho.

example.question: Insha "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi" ina sehemu zipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child writes until the space is full and has not planned the parts.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Insha "Jinsi ya Kupunguza Mawazo Mengi" ina sehemu zipi?" with "aya moja ndefu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Fold the page into three; one part in each; one idea per paragraph in the middle.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vinyume vya Vivumishi (Theme 9: Afya ya akili)
learning_experiences: kutambua vinyume vya vivumishi(k.v. zuri- baya, kali-butu, refu- fupi) katika chati, kadi za maneno, kapu maneno, mti maneno au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kutafuta vinyume vya vivumishi kwa kurejelea orodha ya vivumishi alivyopewa,
kutalii mazingira yake na kuunda orodha ya vinyume vya vivumishi,
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia vinyume vya vivumishi kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni vivumishi vipi unavyoweza kutambua vinyume vyake?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kazi ya vikundi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya mazingira: mwanafunzi anapotalii mazingira yake na kuunda orodha ya vinyume vya vivumishi.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya vinyume vya maneno anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la afya ya akili na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua vinyume vya vivumishi katika matini
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia vinyume vya vivumishi
kuchangamkia matumizi ya vinyume vya vivumishi katika mawasiliano ya kila siku

skills.name: Tambua na tumia vinyume vya vivumishi
skills.mastery: Gives the true opposite of an adjective (mrefu-mfupi, mzito-mwepesi, mwerevu-mjinga) in the form that agrees with the noun, and does not repeat the word or pick a different adjective, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Repeats the word as its own opposite.

example.question: Mfuko huu ni mzito lakini ule ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not read the word lakini that signals a contrast.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mfuko huu ni mzito lakini ule ni ___." with "mzito" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence with lakini and the same word among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume ni neno la maana ya upande wa pili, si neno lilelile.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a different adjective that is not the opposite (mdogo for mfupi).

example.question: Mti huu ni mrefu lakini ule ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child picks a word from the same field (size) without checking it is the exact opposite.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mti huu ni mrefu lakini ule ni ___." with "mdogo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A word with a near neighbour of meaning among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha mrefu ni mfupi. Mdogo ni kinyume cha mkubwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the opposite without the prefix of the noun (refu for mrefu, jinga for mjinga).

example.question: Kiti hiki ni kigumu lakini kile ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child changes the opposite to fit the noun when it does not change, or leaves out the prefix when it must.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kiti hiki ni kigumu lakini kile ni ___." with "kilaini" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with and without the prefix.
misconceptions.feedback: Vivumishi vingi huchukua kiambishi cha nomino (mjinga, wachache). Vingine hubaki kama vilivyo (laini, moto).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Makes the opposite with si- or "si" (si mrefu for mfupi).

example.question: Kinyume cha "mrefu" ni?

misconceptions.cause: Negation is a quick way to say "not", so the child uses it as the opposite.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "mrefu" ni?" with "si mrefu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: An opposite is another adjective: mrefu/mfupi, mpana/mwembamba.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha kivumishi ni kivumishi kingine: mfupi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Sitiari za Tabia (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na ugaidi)
learning_experiences: kujadili na wenzake maana ya sitiari,
kutambua sitiari za tabia (k.v. yeye ni sungura, yeye ni fisi, yeye ni kasuku, mimi ni kobe safarini) katika vitabu, matini, chati na vyombo vya kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutoa mifano ya sitiari za tabia akisaidiana na mwenzake,
kueleza maana ya sitiari mbalimbali,
kutumia sitiari katika sentensi .
key_inquiry_questions: Ni maneno gani unayoweza kutumia kulinganisha kitu na kingine kwa njia ya moja kwa moja?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kazi ya vikundi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotambua sitiari katika matini.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutambua sitiari.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake.
Umoja: anaposhirikiana na wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Kukabiliana na ugaidi: mwanafunzi anapotoa mifano ya stiari akirejelea suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Mtazamo wa ukuaji wa binadamu: mwanafunzi anaposaidiwa na mzazi au mlezi, kutunga sentensi mbalimbali akitumia sitiari za tabia na anapotambua sitiari za tabia katika matini.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusikiliza na kuzungumza anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kukabiliana na ugaidi na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kujadili dhana ya sitiari ili kuitofautisha na dhana zingine za lugha
kutambua sitiari za tabia katika matini mbalimbali ili kuzibainisha
kutumia sitiari za tabia kwa usahihi katika sentensi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
kufurahia matumizi ya sitiari katika mawasiliano ya kila siku

skills.name: Tambua na tumia sitiari za tabia
skills.mastery: Completes a sitiari about behaviour (Kamau ni nyuki, mkuu wa shule ni simba, mwenzako ni kinyonga) and picks the sentence that is a sitiari and not a tashbihi (with kama) or a plain statement, in 8 of 10 new items. Using sitiari in speech (outcome c) stays with the teacher.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 similes of character with kama.

misconceptions.error: Names the wrong animal for the behaviour (kobe for a hard worker).

example.question: Kamau hufanya kazi kutwa nzima bila kuchoka. Kamau ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not link the animal with the behaviour it stands for.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kamau hufanya kazi kutwa nzima bila kuchoka. Kamau ni ___." with "kobe" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A behaviour with several animals among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila mnyama hutumika kuonyesha tabia: nyuki (bidii), simba (ujasiri), kobe (polepole), kinyonga (kubadilika), mbweha (ujanja), tausi (kujionyesha).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a sentence with kama (a tashbihi) for a sitiari.

example.question: Chagua sentensi iliyo sitiari.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not tell the two figures apart.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi iliyo sitiari." with "Mwalimu ni kama simba." among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sitiari and a tashbihi on the same subject.
misconceptions.feedback: Tashbihi hulinganisha kwa kutumia "kama". Sitiari husema moja ni lingine bila "kama".
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes the sitiari word for word (the teacher really has a lion).

example.question: Chagua sentensi iliyo sitiari.

misconceptions.cause: The child reads the sentence as a plain statement.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Chagua sentensi iliyo sitiari." with "Mwalimu ana simba." among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sitiari beside a sentence with the verb kuwa na.
misconceptions.feedback: Sitiari haisemi mtu ana mnyama. Inasema mtu ni mnyama kwa tabia yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses a sitiari whose animal stands for another trait (Amina ni fisi for a kind girl).

example.question: Ni sitiari ipi inamfaa mtu mkarimu?

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the pattern X ni Y but not what each animal stands for.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sitiari ipi inamfaa mtu mkarimu?" with "Yeye ni fisi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Use the folk-tale chart: fisi - ulafi, sungura - ujanja, njiwa - upole, simba - ushujaa.
misconceptions.feedback: Fisi huwakilisha ulafi; njiwa huwakilisha upole.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na ugaidi)
learning_experiences: kutambua mambo ya kuzingatia anaposoma matini zilizohifadhiwa katika kifaa cha kidijitali (k.v. kutofuta kazi za wenzake zilizohifadhiwa katika vifaa vya kidijitali) akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutambua mambo ya kuzingatia anaposoma matini za mtandaoni (k.v. kufungua mitandao ifaayo, kutowasiliana na watu usiowajua, kutofichua nywila yako kwa wenzake),
kutambua jina la faili lengwa kwenye tarakilishi na kufanya mazoezi ya kufungua na kufunga,
kutambua mitandao salama yenye matini inayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake,
kutambua umuhimu wa kutoa habari kwa mwalimu, mzazi au mlezi wake endapo atapata ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandaoni na kutowasiliana nao,
kutafuta maana za maneno mapya kwenye kamusi mtandaoni, kusimulia wenzake habari alizosoma.
key_inquiry_questions: Unakumbuka habari gani uliyoisoma mtandaoni?
Ni hatua gani za kiusalama unazozingatia unapotafuta habari mtandaoni?
sub_strands.core_competences: Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi atapata hamu ya kutafuta matini za kusoma kwenye tarakilishi na mitandaoni.
sub_strands.values: Uwajibikaji: katika utunzaji wa vifaa vya kidijitali na kuzingatia mitandao salama.
sub_strands.pcis:
Usalama wa mitandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotambua mambo ya kuzingatia anaposoma matini za mtandaoni na anapotambua mitandao salama yenye matini inayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake.
Usalama na ulinzi: mwanafunzi anapofahamu namna anavyoweza kujizuia na ulaghai wa mtandaoni kwa kutowasiliana na watu asiowajua na kutoa habari kwa mwalimu au mzazi endapo atapata ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandaoni.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa mapana anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kukabiliana na ugaidi na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.
Masomo yote kwa vile yanatakiwa kuzingatia ujuzi wa kidijitali.

outcomes.text: kutambua na kufungua faili iliyo na kifungu cha kusoma ili kuimarisha umilisi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi
kuonyesha uelewa wa hatua za kiusalama kwa kusakura matini kwenye tovuti salama ili kupata vifungu vya kusoma kutumia vyombo vya kidijitali
kuchangamkia matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutafuta na kusoma ujumbe ili kuimarisha maarifa yake

skills.name: Fungua faili, sakura kwenye tovuti salama na usome matini ya kidijitali
skills.mastery: Opens a saved file with the passage (finds the folder, double-clicks the file), searches a safe site with two or three key words, ignores pop-ups and adverts, and reads the passage for its message, in 8 of 10 new items or tasks.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 4 searched and read digital texts.
Safety steps.

misconceptions.error: Mixes up a folder and a file: looks for the passage on the screen without opening the folder it is in.

example.question: Kifungu "Usalama wa Jamii" kimehifadhiwa ndani ya folda "Kiswahili". Utakifunguaje?
example.wrong_answer: bonyeza "Usalama wa Jamii" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo
example.correct_answer: fungua folda "Kiswahili", kisha bonyeza mara mbili faili "Usalama wa Jamii"

misconceptions.cause: The child has only used apps on a phone, where there are no folders.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kifungu "Usalama wa Jamii" kimehifadhiwa ndani ya folda "Kiswahili". Utakifunguaje?" with "bonyeza "Usalama wa Jamii" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show a real folder (a box file) holding papers; then the same on the screen.
misconceptions.feedback: Faili huhifadhiwa ndani ya folda; fungua folda kwanza, kisha faili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Types a whole long question, with spelling mistakes, into the search box.

example.question: Unatafuta habari kuhusu kukabiliana na ugaidi. Utaandika nini kwenye kisanduku cha kutafutia?
example.wrong_answer: naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu kukabiliana na ugaidi tafadhali

misconceptions.cause: The child talks to the search box as to a person.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unatafuta habari kuhusu kukabiliana na ugaidi. Utaandika nini kwenye kisanduku cha kutafutia?" with "naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu kukabiliana na ugaidi tafadhali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the two or three words that carry the meaning; search with those; compare the results.
misconceptions.feedback: Andika maneno mawili au matatu muhimu tu, na uyaandike kwa tahajia sahihi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Clicks a pop-up or an advert that says he has won a prize.

example.question: Ukiwa unasoma, ujumbe unatokea: "Umeshinda simu! Bonyeza hapa." Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: usibonyeze; funga ujumbe na umwambie mwalimu au mzazi

misconceptions.cause: Offers of prizes are exciting and the child does not know they are traps.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ukiwa unasoma, ujumbe unatokea: "Umeshinda simu! Bonyeza hapa." Ufanye nini?" with "bonyeza ili kupokea simu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show two screenshots, one real page and one trap; the child finds three signs of the trap.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe wa zawadi usiotarajiwa ni mtego; usiubonyeze.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses any site that comes up and gives his name, school or phone number when a site asks.

example.question: Tovuti inakuuliza jina lako kamili, shule yako na nambari ya simu ya mzazi kabla ya kusoma hadithi. Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: usijaze; tumia tovuti salama aliyokupa mwalimu

misconceptions.cause: The child wants the story and does not see personal details as worth protecting.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tovuti inakuuliza jina lako kamili, shule yako na nambari ya simu ya mzazi kabla ya kusoma hadithi. Ufanye nini?" with "jaza ili usome hadithi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: List the details that are private; practise saying no to a form.
misconceptions.feedback: Usimpe mtu yeyote mtandaoni jina lako kamili, shule yako wala nambari ya simu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the steps of finding and reading a passage in the wrong order (reads before searching, or searches before switching on).

example.question: Ni hatua ipi huja kwanza?

misconceptions.cause: The child has watched an adult do the steps quickly and remembers the parts, not the order.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni hatua ipi huja kwanza?" with "andika maneno ya kutafutia" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Step cards: the child orders them, then does them on a real device.
misconceptions.feedback: Washa kifaa, fungua kivinjari, andika maneno muhimu, chagua tovuti salama, soma.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha za Masimulizi (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na ugaidi)
learning_experiences: kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,
kujadili mada na vidokezo vya insha ili kuvitumia katika kuandika insha yake,
kuelezea maudhui atakayotumia kuandikia insha ya masimulizi,

kuandika insha ya masimulizi (k.v. kuhusu ugaidi, uhalifu, ajali, safari n.k) isiyopungua maneno 200 akizingatia mada, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka, lugha ya kiubunifu na urefu unaotarajiwa. Pia azingatie aina mbalimbali za maneno, mnyambuliko wa vitenzi, na nyakati ili kejenga picha dhahiri ya anachokiandikia daftarini,
kuandika insha ya masimulizi katika vifaa vya kidijitali na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini,
kuwawasilishia wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini na kumwelekeza.
key_inquiry_questions: Insha ya masimulizi ina sifa gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya mawasiliano.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maswali dadisi yaliyopendekezwa na anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapowajibika katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali.
sub_strands.pcis:
Kukabiliana na ugaidi: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi kuhusu suala lengwa (k.v. kuhusu ugaidi, uhalifu)
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi katika vifaa vya kidijitali na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili kuisoma na kuitathmini.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kukabiliana na ugaidi na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies. Shughuli za Ujifunzaji Zilizopendekezwa Swali Dadisi

outcomes.text: kueleza maudhui ya insha ya masimulizi ili kuandika ifaavyo
kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo
kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri ili kuimarisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na andika insha ya masimulizi
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya masimulizi from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a story of events in the past tense, in order, with a title, an opening, a middle and a closing that gives the lesson; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 8 wrote a masimulizi with a clear flow.
The features of a masimulizi.

misconceptions.error: Writes facts or an explanation where a story of events is asked.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?
example.wrong_answer: Ugaidi ni tishio kwa usalama wa nchi.
example.correct_answer: Mlinzi aliona mfuko mweusi ukiwa peke yake kituoni.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows a lot about the topic and writes what he knows instead of telling what happened.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?" with "Ugaidi ni tishio kwa usalama wa nchi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: who, where, what happened first, then, in the end? A story answers these; an explanation does not.
misconceptions.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio yaliyotokea: nani, wapi, nini kilitokea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Tells a past story in the present tense (-na-), or mixes -na- and -li- in one story.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?
example.wrong_answer: Mlinzi anaona mfuko mweusi ukiwa peke yake kituoni.
example.correct_answer: Mlinzi aliona mfuko mweusi ukiwa peke yake kituoni.

misconceptions.cause: The child writes as he speaks while remembering, and English stories in class are told in the present too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?" with "Mlinzi anaona mfuko mweusi ukiwa peke yake kituoni." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Circle every verb; check its tense marker against the time words (jana, siku moja).
misconceptions.feedback: Jambo lililotokea husimuliwa kwa wakati uliopita: -li-.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?
example.wrong_answer: mfuko ulikaguliwa, polisi walifika, aliwaonya watu, mlinzi aliona mfuko
example.correct_answer: mlinzi aliona mfuko, aliwaonya watu, polisi walifika, mfuko ulikaguliwa

misconceptions.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?" with "mfuko ulikaguliwa, polisi walifika, aliwaonya watu, mlinzi aliona mfuko" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza kuwa mwangalifu kila wakati.

misconceptions.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
misconceptions.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Mlinzi aliona mfuko mweusi ukiwa peke yake kituoni.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Mfuko Uliotiliwa Shaka", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Hali ya Masharti (nge,ngali na ki) (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na ugaidi)
learning_experiences: kutambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti (nge, ngali, ki) kwenye vitenzi katika chati, ubao au kwa kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali,
kutumia vitenzi vya hali ya masharti katika sentensi kwa kuandika daftarini au kupiga chapa kwenye tarakilishi/kipakatalishi,
kubadilisha sentensi kutoka hali moja hadi nyingine,
kutunga sentensi katika hali ya mazoea na hali ya masharti mtandaoni na kuwatumia wenzake waweze kuzisoma na kutathmini usahihi wake.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unajua viambishi vipi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za ujifunzaji na wenzake darasani na mtandaoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoendelea kutunga sentensi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kipakatalishi au tarakilishi kutunga sentensi na vile vile kuzisambaza mtandaoni.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapojifunza kuthamini maoni ya wenzake.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Kukabiliana na ugaidi: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi katika hali ya mazoea na hali ya masharti kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi katika hali ya mazoea na hali ya masharti mtandaoni na kuwatumia wenzake waweze kuzisoma na kutathmini usahihi wake.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya hali ya masharti anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kukabiliana na ugaidi na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti kwenye kitenzi
kutumia vitenzi katika hali ya masharti kwenye sentensi
kufurahia matumizi ya hali ya masharti katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na tumia hali ya masharti
skills.mastery: Uses -ki-, -sipo- and -nge- for a condition (Ukisoma, utafaulu; Usipomwagilia, itakauka; Ningekuwa tajiri, ningejenga) and does not use a tense marker (-li-, -na-, -ta-) in its place, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 met the aspects hu- and -me-; -ki-, -nge-, -ngali- are the next markers.

misconceptions.error: Uses a tense marker (-li-, -na-, -ta-) where a condition marker (-ki-, -nge-) is needed.

example.question: ___ kwa bidii, utafaulu mtihani.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows tenses and not the condition marker.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "___ kwa bidii, utafaulu mtihani." with "Ulisoma" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence with if in the meaning and tense forms among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Sharti linaonyeshwa kwa -ki-, -sipo- au -nge-, si kwa -li-, -na- au -ta-.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses -sipo- (do not) where the condition is to do (-ki-).

example.question: Wanafunzi ___ pamoja, watamaliza kazi haraka.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not read the whole sentence for meaning.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wanafunzi ___ pamoja, watamaliza kazi haraka." with "wasipofanya" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A condition whose result only makes sense if it is positive.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma sentensi nzima. Kama matokeo ni mazuri, sharti ni la kufanya (-ki-).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Names the tense marker (-ta-) as the condition marker.

example.question: Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Ukisoma, utafaulu"?

misconceptions.cause: The child finds a marker in the verb but picks the wrong one.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Ukisoma, utafaulu"?" with "-ta-" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A sentence with both -ki- and -ta- and both in the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Ta- huonyesha wakati ujao. Ki- huonyesha sharti.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Names the person prefix (u-, a-, ni-) as the condition marker.

example.question: Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Angekuja, angeona"?

misconceptions.cause: The child picks the first marker in the verb.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kiambishi kipi cha masharti katika "Angekuja, angeona"?" with "-a-" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A verb with a person prefix and a condition marker.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiambishi cha mtu (u-, a-, ni-) hakionyeshi sharti. Sharti ni -ki-, -sipo-, -nge-.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kujieleza kwa Ufasaha (Theme 11: Ushuru)
learning_experiences: kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu mada mbalimbali ambazo huweza kusimuliwa kuhusiana na mambo na hali za maisha (k.v. hadithi za mashujaa, shughuli za sikukuu za kitaifa, usomaji wa bajeti, ulipaji wa ushuru, hekaya),
kusikiliza kisa cha kisimulizi kuhusu mada lengwa kutoka kwa mgeni mwalikwa, tepurekoda, video na tarakilishi ili kupata sifa za usimulizi mzuri,

kusimulia kisa kuhusiana na mada fulani akizingatia mtiririko wa matukio, kanuni za kisarufi, kupanda na kushuka kwa sauti, ishara za uso, viziada lugha, tasfida, na wakati ili kuufanya utungo wake uvutie,
wa mawazo, mfuatano wa kuuliza na kujibu maswali kutokana na visa vilivyosimuliwa darasani.
key_inquiry_questions: Masimulizi kuhusu ushuru yana umuhimu gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga na kusimulia kisa kuhusu mambo mbalimbali katika jamii.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposimama mbele ya hadhira na kusimulia kisa.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza masimulizi kupitia vifaa vya kielektroniki.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitahidi kusimulia.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutoa masimulizi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya kifedha: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu mada mbalimbali ambazo huweza kusimuliwa kuhusiana na mambo na hali za maisha ikiwemo ulipaji wa ushuru.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Mahusiano ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikisha hadhira kupitia uimbaji, kupiga makofi, kucheza, kuitikia ili kuupa usimulizi wake uhai zaidi na kuteka makini ya wasikilizaji.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kutoa masimulizi na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la ushuru na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kubuni na kusimulia kisa mbele ya wenzake akizingatia mada lengwa
kutumia ishara zifaazo kuimarisha masimulizi yake
kufurahia usimulizi wa visa mbalimbali kuhusu maisha

skills.name: Sikiliza masimulizi kwa ujumbe na usimulie kwa ishara zifaazo
skills.mastery: Listens to a short narration and gives its message (not a detail), retells it in order, and tells his own story on the topic in Kiswahili sanifu with gestures that match the words; the teacher scores the telling with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the message, order or gesture in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Grade 5 told a narration with gestures.
Telling a story to the class is a semi-formal setting.

misconceptions.error: Gives a detail of the narration as its message.

example.question: Ulisikiliza masimulizi kuhusu wanakijiji waliojenga barabara kwa pesa za ushuru. Ujumbe wake ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tukilipa ushuru, serikali hutujengea huduma kama barabara na shule.

misconceptions.cause: The detail was vivid; the child has not asked what the whole narration teaches.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ulisikiliza masimulizi kuhusu wanakijiji waliojenga barabara kwa pesa za ushuru. Ujumbe wake ni upi?" with "Barabara mpya ilikuwa ya lami." among the options.
misconceptions.help: After listening, ask: what did the speaker want us to learn? Then: what is one thing that happened?
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe ni funzo la masimulizi yote; jambo moja ni maelezo tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Retells the events in a mixed order, starting with the most exciting part.

example.question: Unaposimulia, unaanza na nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child jumps to the part that impressed him most.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unaposimulia, unaanza na nini?" with "sehemu ya kusisimua zaidi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Retell with three fingers: mwanzo, kati, mwisho.
misconceptions.feedback: Simulia kwa mpangilio: mwanzo, kati, mwisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses gestures or a face that do not match the words (smiles while telling a sad part, stands still for an action).

example.question: Unasimulia: "Tuliiona barabara ndefu ikinyooka hadi mjini!" Ishara ipi inafaa?

misconceptions.cause: The child is nervous and does not link the body to the words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unasimulia: "Tuliiona barabara ndefu ikinyooka hadi mjini!" Ishara ipi inafaa?" with "kukunja mikono kifuani" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Mirror game in pairs: one says a line, the other shows the feeling; swap.
misconceptions.feedback: Ishara na sura yako ziendane na unachosema.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes English or Sheng into the telling (Then tukaenda..., ilikuwa poa sana).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa unaposimulia darasani?
example.wrong_answer: Then tukaenda home, ilikuwa poa sana.
example.correct_answer: Kisha tukaenda nyumbani; ilikuwa siku nzuri sana.

misconceptions.cause: The child narrates as he talks with friends.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa unaposimulia darasani?" with "Then tukaenda home, ilikuwa poa sana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Record a telling; play it back; the child finds the non-Kiswahili words and replaces them.
misconceptions.feedback: Simulia kwa Kiswahili sanifu: kisha, nyumbani, nzuri.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Tells a story that is not on the topic given (ushuru (taxes)).

example.question: Mada ni ushuru (taxes). Ni masimulizi yapi yanafaa?
example.correct_answer: Siku wanakijiji waliojenga barabara kwa pesa za ushuru

misconceptions.cause: The child tells the story he knows best, whatever the topic.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mada ni ushuru (taxes). Ni masimulizi yapi yanafaa?" with "Siku nilipotazama mechi ya mpira" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Write the topic on the board; before telling, the child says in one sentence how his story fits it.
misconceptions.feedback: Masimulizi yako yahusu mada uliyopewa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufasaha (Theme 11: Ushuru)
learning_experiences: kujadiliana na wenzake vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma makala kwa ufasaha,
kusoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa katika matini andishi au ya kidijitali akizingatia matamshi bora,
kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno sahihi yasiyopungua 85 kwa dakika) ili wenzake wamtolee maoni,
kusoma kifungu akizingatia sauti ifaayo (k.v. kiwango cha sauti na kiimbo),
kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo panapofaa (k.v. ishara za uso na mikono zinazozingatia tamaduni),
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kusoma makala akizingatia vipengele vya usomaji bora.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, kusoma kwa ufasaha kuna umuhimu gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kujadiliana kuhusu vipengele vya kusoma kwa ufasaha.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kwa ufasaha.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotumia ishara zifaazo wakati wa kusoma kifungu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli ya kusoma.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji wanapojadili vipengele vya usomaji bora.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kushiriki katika mjadala wakati wa shughuli ya ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuwasomea wenzake kifungu.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake kujadili vipengele vya usomaji bora.
sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kijamii na kitaifa: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa ufasaha na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la ushuru na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma kwa ufasaha
kusoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora
kusoma kifungu kwa kasi ifaayo
kusoma kifungu kwa kutumia sauti ipasavyo
kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo
kuchangamkia kusoma kifungu kwa kuzingatia vipengele vya usomaji kwa ufasaha

skills.name: Soma kifungu kwa sauti kwa matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo, sauti ifaayo na ishara
skills.mastery: Reads a short passage aloud at a speaking pace, pauses at the koma and the kikomo, raises the voice for a question and shows feeling for an exclamation, says every sound clearly (no l for r), and uses a matching gesture, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app picks the better reading of a line in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 3 reading aloud.
The features of fluent reading.

misconceptions.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Serikali hutumia ushuru kujenga hospitali, shule na barabara."?
example.wrong_answer: Serikali ... hutumia ... ushuru ... kujenga ... hospitali, ... shule ... na ... barabara.
example.correct_answer: Serikali hutumia ushuru kujenga hospitali, shule na barabara.

misconceptions.cause: The child is still decoding each word and has not yet learnt to read a phrase as one piece.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Serikali hutumia ushuru kujenga hospitali, shule na barabara."?" with "Serikali ... hutumia ... ushuru ... kujenga ... hospitali, ... shule ... na ... barabara." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.
misconceptions.feedback: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, ili kila neno lisikike

misconceptions.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; the child has not been asked whether listeners understood.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Time two readings: one very fast, one at speaking pace; listeners answer one question after each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a question and an exclamation in the same flat voice as a statement.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, unajua ushuru hulipwa wapi?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the mark at the end.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, unajua ushuru hulipwa wapi?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that matches each reading.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads on through the koma and the kikomo without a pause.

example.question: Unasoma: "Hongera, umelipa ushuru kwa wakati!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?
example.wrong_answer: hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: kwenye koma na kwenye kikomo au alama ya hisi

misconceptions.cause: The marks are read as decoration; the child has not linked them to breath.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unasoma: "Hongera, umelipa ushuru kwa wakati!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?" with "hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap once at a koma, twice at a kikomo while reading together.
misconceptions.feedback: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Says /l/ for /r/ or /r/ for /l/ while reading (serikali read as selikali).

example.question: Neno "serikali" linatamkwa vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The first language of the child does not separate these sounds, so the reading carries the home sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "serikali" linatamkwa vipi?" with "selikali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make a list of the passage words with the hard sound; practise them before reading the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Tamka "serikali" kama lilivyoandikwa; "selikali" ni neno jingine au si neno.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Barua Rasmi (Theme 11: Ushuru)
learning_experiences: kutambua mada ya kuandikia barua rasmi,
kujadili na wenzake maudhui yafaayo kulingana na mada ya insha ya barua rasmi,
kuandika vidokezo vya kumwongoza,
kujadili na wenzake vipengele vya aya,
kuandika barua rasmi kwa mwalimu daftarini kuomba msamaha na kuiwasilisha kila hoja katika aya yake,
kutumia sentensi inayobeba wazo kuu mwanzoni mwa kila aya,
kuandika kwa hati safi au kwa kutumia tarakilishi huku akizingatia kanuni zifaazo,.
kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu umuhimu wa barua rasmi katika mawasiliano.
key_inquiry_questions: Uandishi wa barua rasmi huzingatia vipengele gani?
Unazingatia nini ili kuunda aya nzuri?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga na kuandika barua rasmi kwa mwalimu.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapoandika barua kwa kutumia tarakilishi.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili maudhui ya barua rasmi.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapozingatia maoni ya wenzake wakati wa mijadala.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapoandika barua rasmi kuomba msamaha.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya kifedha: mwanafunzi anapoandika barua rasmi kuhusu suala lengwa.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika barua rasmi na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la ushuru na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kujadili maudhui ili kuandika barua rasmi inayozingatia mada
kuandika barua rasmi inayozingatia mada, hati safi, muundo na mtindo ufaao ili kuwasiliana ipasavyo
kuchangamkia utunzi wa barua rasmi katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Andika barua rasmi kwa muundo na lugha ifaayo
skills.mastery: Tells barua rasmi from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes an official letter with two addresses, the date, a formal greeting, a KUH: line, the message and Wako mtiifu with a signature; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Theme 4 wrote the first official letter.
The parts of an official letter.

misconceptions.error: Writes only one address, or puts the receiver's address at the top right.

example.question: Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?
example.correct_answer: mbili: ya mwandishi (kulia juu) na ya mpokeaji (kushoto)

misconceptions.cause: The friendly letter has one address and the child carries it over.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Barua rasmi ina anwani ngapi?" with "moja, ya mwandishi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Label both addresses on a model; the child writes his own and the receiver's on a blank layout.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi ina anwani mbili: ya mwandishi kulia juu, ya mpokeaji kushoto chini yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out the subject line (KUH: or YAH:) or writes it as a long sentence.

example.question: Ni kichwa kipi kinafaa katika barua rasmi kuhusu ombi la kuelimishwa kuhusu ushuru?
example.wrong_answer: Nimeandika barua hii kwa sababu ninataka kukueleza mambo mengi.
example.correct_answer: KUH: OMBI LA KUELIMISHWA KUHUSU USHURU

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know the reader of an official letter needs the subject before reading.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kichwa kipi kinafaa katika barua rasmi kuhusu ombi la kuelimishwa kuhusu ushuru?" with "Nimeandika barua hii kwa sababu ninataka kukueleza mambo mengi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the KUH: line on three real letters; it is short and in capitals.
misconceptions.feedback: Kichwa cha barua rasmi huanza KUH: au YAH: na huandikwa kwa herufi kubwa, kwa ufupi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses friendly words in an official letter (Mpendwa rafiki, Hujambo?, Wako akupendaye).

example.question: Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa Mwalimu Mkuu?

misconceptions.cause: The friendly letter is the first letter learnt and its words come first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa Mwalimu Mkuu?" with "Hujambo mwalimu wangu mpendwa!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort salamu and closing cards into "kirafiki" and "rasmi".
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha rasmi: Kwa Mwalimu Mkuu, Wako mtiifu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends with only a first name and no signature, or with "Ni mimi rafiki yako".

example.question: Barua rasmi humalizika vipi?
example.correct_answer: Wako mtiifu, sahihi, na jina kamili: Wanjiku Kamau

misconceptions.cause: The friendly closing is a habit.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Barua rasmi humalizika vipi?" with "Ni mimi rafiki yako, Wanjiku" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Model the closing block (Wako mtiifu, sahihi, jina kamili) and have the child copy it once.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua rasmi humalizika kwa "Wako mtiifu," sahihi na jina kamili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ukanushaji wa Maneno (Theme 11: Ushuru)
learning_experiences: kutambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti (nge, ngali, ki) katika vitenzi kwa kuvipigia mistari kwenye vitabu au kuvikolezea wino kwenye tarakilishi,
kutambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika hali kanushi (k.v.singe, singali, sipo),
kusoma sentensi zenye viambishi lengwa kwenye vitabu au tarakilishi katika hali yakinishi na kanushi,
kukanusha maneno na sentensi akizingatia hali ya masharti kwenye daftari au kwa kutumia tarakilishi,
kutunga sentensi sahihi zenye viambishi vya hali ya masharti na kuzikanusha,
kusikiliza au kutazama vipindi vya ukanushaji wa hali ya masharti kupitia vifaa vya kidijitali.
key_inquiry_questions: Viambishi vya hali ya mashartikatika vitenzi nivipi?
Viambishi vya hali ya mashartikatika ukanushaji ni vipi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika vikundi ili kujadili kuhusu ukanushaji.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapojaribu kukanusha maneno na sentensi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika somo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenazake katika kazi ya vikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya kifedha: mwanafunzi anapotambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti kuhusu suala lengwa na kutunga sentensi. .
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza au kutazama vipindi vya ukanushaji wa hali ya masharti kupitia vifaa vya kidijitali.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ukanushaji wa maneno na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la ushuru na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika sentensi
kukanusha viambishi vya hali ya masharti katika sentensi
kufurahia ukanushaji wa viambishi hali ya masharti katika sentensi

skills.name: Kanusha viambishi vya hali ya masharti
skills.mastery: Makes the negative of a verb with -ki- by changing -ki- to -sipo- (Ukisoma, Usiposoma) and does not only add si- or keep -ki-, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Only puts si- in front and keeps -ki- (Usikisoma for Usiposoma).

example.question: Neno "Ukisoma" likikanushwa huwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child applies the rule for negating a command or a tense to the conditional.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "Ukisoma" likikanushwa huwa ___." with "Usikisoma" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A conditional verb with the si-form among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Katika ukanushaji wa masharti, ki- hubadilika kuwa -sipo-: Ukisoma, Usiposoma.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Negates with ha- and keeps -ki- (Hukisoma, Hakija).

example.question: Neno "Akija" likikanushwa huwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child applies the rule for negating a tense to the conditional.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "Akija" likikanushwa huwa ___." with "Hakija" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A conditional verb with the ha-form among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Ha- haikanushi -ki-. Ki- hubadilika kuwa -sipo-.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the negative command (Usisome, Asije) for the negative condition.

example.question: Neno "Ukisoma" likikanushwa huwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the negative command and uses it for every negative.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "Ukisoma" likikanushwa huwa ___." with "Usisome" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A conditional verb with the negative command among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Usisome ni amri ya kutosoma. Sharti hasi la Ukisoma ni Usiposoma.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Negates -nge- with ha- and keeps it whole (hangekuja) instead of the si- form (asingekuja).

example.question: Kanusha: Angekuja, tungefurahi.

misconceptions.cause: Ha- is the negative the child knows best.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kanusha: Angekuja, tungefurahi." with "Hangekuja, hatungefurahi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show the pattern: -nge- negates with -singe-: asingekuja, tusingefurahi.
misconceptions.feedback: Hali ya -nge- hukanushwa kwa -singe-: asingekuja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino (Theme 11: Ushuru)
learning_experiences: kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa kiambishi Ki- (k.v. kiti, kitabu, kitanda) kwa kutumia kadi za maneno, mti wa maneno, chati au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kushiriki kwenye mjadala wa kutambua viambishi vinavyotumika kudhihirisha ukubwa na udogo wa nomino,
kushiriki katika vikundi kubadilisha nomino kutoka hali ya wastani hadi hali ya ukubwa na udogo,
kushiriki katika mchezo wa vikundi ambapo kikundi kimoja kitataja wastani wa nomino na kingine kutaja ukubwa na udogo wa nomino hiyo,
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia nomino hizo katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni nomino gani zinazoanza kwa kiambishi ki-unazozijua?
sub_strands.core_competences:
