Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki mijadala kuhusu mada ya ukubwa na udogo wa nomino.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua na kuambatanisha nomino katika hali ya wastani, ukubwa na udogo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake wanapojadili.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Mahusiano ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anapoashiriki katika mchezo wa vikundi ambapo kikundi kimoja kitataja wastani wa nomino na kingine kutaja ukubwa na udogo wa nomino hiyo.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ukubwa na udogo wa nomino na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la ushuru na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies. Shughuli za Ujifunzaji Swali Dadisi

outcomes.text: kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa kiambishi ki- katika kundi la maneno
kubadilisha nomino, zinazoanza kwa ki- katika hali wastani kuwa katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo
kutunga sentensi sahihi akitumia nomino zinazoanza kwa ki- katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo huku akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi
kufurahia kutumia nomino zinazoanza kwa ki- kwa usahihi katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Badilisha nomino za ki- kuwa ukubwa na udogo
skills.mastery: Gives the big form (ji-) and the small form (kiji-) of nouns that begin with ki- (kitabu: jitabu, kijitabu) and their plurals (majitabu, vijitabu), in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Swaps the big form (ji-) and the small form (kiji-).

example.question: Kitabu kikubwa sana huitwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child learned both forms but not which is for big and which for small.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kitabu kikubwa sana huitwa ___." with "kijitabu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A big or small noun with both forms among the options.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukubwa hupata ji-, udogo hupata kiji-. Kijitabu ni kitabu kidogo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the plain plural (vitabu) where the big or small form is asked.

example.question: Kitabu kikubwa sana huitwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child confuses a big thing with many things.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kitabu kikubwa sana huitwa ___." with "vitabu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with the plain plural.
misconceptions.feedback: Vitabu ni wingi wa kitabu. Kitabu kikubwa sana ni jitabu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves the noun unchanged (kitabu for jitabu or kijitabu).

example.question: Kisu kidogo huitwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not see that size changes the noun.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kisu kidogo huitwa ___." with "kisu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with the plain noun.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukubwa na udogo hubadilisha mwanzo wa nomino: kisu, kijisu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the singular where the plural is asked.

example.question: Wingi wa "jitabu" ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not read the word wingi.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "jitabu" ni ___." with "jitabu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Options with the singular.
misconceptions.feedback: Wingi wa jitabu ni majitabu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino (Theme 11: Ushuru)
learning_experiences: kutaja nomino zinazoanza kwa kiambishi ji- katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo kwa kutumia kadi maneno, mti maneno, chati au vifaa vya kidijitali k.v. jani (jijani - kijani), jiko (jijiko -kijijiko),
kushiriki kwenye mjadala wa kutambua viambishi vinavyotumika kudhihirisha ukubwa na udogo wa nomino zinazoanza kwa kiambishi Ji-,
kubadilisha nomino kutoka hali ya wastani hadi hali ya ukubwa na udogo,
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia nomino hizo katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni nomino gani zinazoanza kwa kiambishi ji-unazozijua?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki mijadala kuhusu mada hii.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi katika hali ya udogo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua na kuambatanisha nomino katika hali ya wastani na udogo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake wanapojadili.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi kwa kushirikiana na wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Elimu ya kifedha: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia udogo na ukubwa kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ukubwa na udogo wa nomino na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la ushuru na yanayofundishwa katika somo la Socia Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa kiambishi ji- ili kuzibainisha
kubadilisha nomino zinazoanza kwa kiambishi ji- katika hali wastani kuwa katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo
kutunga sentensi sahihi akitumia nomino zinazoanza kwa kiambishi ji- katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo huku akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi
kufurahia kutumia nomino zinazoanza kwa kiambishi Ji- kwa usahihi katika hali ya ukubwa na udogo ili kuimarisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Badilisha nomino za ji- kuwa ukubwa na udogo
skills.mastery: Recognises nouns that already begin with ji- (jiwe, jicho, jino), makes the big form by adding ji- again or with jiji-/ji- as the dictionary gives it (jiwe -> jijiwe) and the small form with kiji- (kijiwe), and agrees each with LI-YA or KI-VI, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: The big and small forms of ki- nouns come first in the same theme.
Grade 5 made big and small forms of m- nouns.

misconceptions.error: Drops the ji- of the noun before adding the small prefix (kiwe for kijiwe).

example.question: Udogo wa "jiwe" ni?

misconceptions.cause: For m- and ki- nouns the old prefix is dropped first, and the child does the same with ji-, which here is part of the stem.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Udogo wa "jiwe" ni?" with "kiwe" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show that jiwe has no plain root -we that is used alone; keep jiwe whole and add ki-.
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa nomino za ji- kama jiwe, ji- inabaki: kijiwe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Thinks a ji- noun is already in the big form and leaves it unchanged (jiwe for jijiwe).

example.question: Ukubwa wa "jicho" ni?

misconceptions.cause: ji- is the big prefix the child learnt, so a noun that starts with it looks big already.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ukubwa wa "jicho" ni?" with "jicho" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Compare jiwe (an ordinary stone) and jitu (a giant from mtu); the first ji- is part of the noun.
misconceptions.feedback: Jicho ni hali ya wastani; ukubwa wake ni jijicho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the small form but keeps the LI-YA agreement (kijiwe limeanguka for kijiwe kimeanguka).

example.question: Jaza: Kijiwe ___ (kimeanguka / limeanguka).

misconceptions.cause: The child changes the noun and keeps the agreement of jiwe.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kijiwe ___ (kimeanguka / limeanguka)." with "limeanguka" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The small form moves to KI-VI: kijiwe kimeanguka, vijiwe vimeanguka.
misconceptions.feedback: Udogo huchukua KI-VI: kijiwe kimeanguka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Makes the plural of the small form with ma- (makijiwe) or of the big form with vi- (vijijiwe).

example.question: Wingi wa "kijiwe" ni?

misconceptions.cause: The child adds the plural prefix of the ordinary noun (mawe) to the new form.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "kijiwe" ni?" with "makijiwe" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Small forms take vi- in the plural (vijiwe); big forms take ma- (majijiwe).
misconceptions.feedback: Wingi wa kijiwe ni vijiwe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

rubrics.heading: Mwongozo wa viwango na vigezo vya kutathmini: Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kuwasiliana kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora (matamshi ya sauti zinazokaribiana: d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj, g/ng)

levels.EE: Anawasiliana kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora ya sauti lengwa kila wakati.
levels.ME: Anawasiliana kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora ya sauti lengwa.
levels.AE: Anawasiliana kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora ya baadhi ya sauti lengwa.
levels.BE: Anawasiliana kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora ya baadhi ya sauti lengwa kwa kuelekezwa. Anazungumza na kujieleza

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kuzungumza na kujieleza kwa ufasaha (kwa kutumia maneno ya heshima,adabu na vyeo)

levels.EE: Anazungumza na kujieleza kwa ufasaha na kikamilifu akitumia maneno ya heshima adabu na vyeo katika miktadha
levels.ME: Anazungumza na kujieleza kwa ufasaha akitumia maneno ya heshima, adabu na vyeo katika miktadha
levels.AE: Anazungumza na kujieleza kwa ufasaha akitumia baadhi ya maneno ya heshima, adabu na vyeo katika miktadha mbalimbali.
levels.BE: kwa ufasaha akitumia baadhi ya maneno ya heshima, adabu na vyeo katika baadhi ya miktadha.

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kusikiliza na kujibu ipasavyo (maamkuzi na maagano ,mazungumzo ya kimuktadha)

levels.EE: Anasikiliza na kujibu maamkuzi na maagano kwa kuzingatia miktadha ifaayo kwa wepesi.
levels.ME: Anasikiliza na kujibu maamkuzi na maagano kwa kuzingatia miktadha ifaayo
levels.AE: Anasikiliza na kujibu baadhi ya maamkuzi na maagano kwa kuizingatia miktadha ifaayo.
levels.BE: Anasikiliza na kujibu baadhi ya maamkuzi na maagano na kuzingatia baadhi ya miktadha ifaayo kwa kuelekezwa.

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kutumia lugha kiubunifu (vitendawili, methali nahau, visawe,sitiari za tabia,masimulizi)

levels.EE: Anatumia lugha kiubunifu kwa kurejelea vitendawili, methali, nahau, visawe, sitiari za tabia na masimulizi kwa utendeti.
levels.ME: Anatumia lugha kiubunifu kwa kurejelea vitendawili, methali, nahau, visawe, sitiari za tabia na masimulizi.
levels.AE: Anatumia lugha kiubunifu kwa kurejelea baadhi ya vitendawili, methali, nahau, visawe, sitiari za tabia na masimulizi.
levels.BE: Anatumia lugha kiubunifu kwa kurejelea baadhi ya vitendawili, methali, nahau, visawe, sitiari za tabia na masimulizi kwa kusaidiwa.
